My friend and I both encounter harsh TAs. Awful experience. And professor is really good, he said to his TAs that you can offer extra credit, but my TA said she prefer not :)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Good professor, although lectures need to all be attended because lecture slides include no info. Also TA's are HARD! If you're looking for an easy filler, this is probably not it...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor at UNC! Whether you enjoy history, sports or none of the above, Professor Andrews is an amazing lecturer and engages with the material and students well. He provides a nuanced perspective and has shifted the way I view sports in America. This is my third course with Professor Andrews and hopefully not my last.
Best professor ever.
Probably the best professor at UNC available. Amazing lectures, unique and creative teachings and unmatched personality.

I only took this class to fill hours and it was by far my favorite class this semester! Every lecture just absolutely amazing which made writing the papers super easy. If you ever have the opportunity to take a class with Prof Andrews, do it!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Andrews is as amazing as people say. I took this class for an easy gen ed and was sucked into every lecture. You are graded on only 2 papers, a final, and a few quizzes, and your TA determines your grade. However, andrews is always available to help and chat with students. You can just tell every student in his class loves him.

Professor Andrews is my favorite lecturer I've had at UNC. Papers and assignments are very manageable, although the difficulty of grading entirely depends upon your TA. I highly recommend taking any of Andrews' courses for anyone looking to fulfill a History or gen-ed requirement!

Literally everything good ever said about Matt Andrews is true. His lectures are engaging, he's so easy to look at, and he's a genuinely kind-hearted person. He cares about people, and not just his students. He cares about social issues and change, and you can tell that by the way he lectures and communicates with his students.

It helps that he teaches really cool classes but he could make pottery entertaining. Super good guy, loves to talk about anything remotely related to the course after class/during office hours. Will be taking more of his classes.

Yeah, this guy is the goat.  One of those classes which you actually look forward to. You just sit back and listen to a knowledgeable guy talk about sports stories he clearly loves. Get off Rate My Professor and just sign up already.

Wonderful and funny professor who provides very detailed lectures. He really deserves his great reputation. This is the second course I've taken with him and it was just as engaging and interesting. A few assignments but none are particularly hard. Would highly recommend to any history or non-history major.

One of the best professors at UNC. Grades on a few things (essays, easy quizzes, final, and recitation participation). Grading was a bit harder because TA graded tougher, but she was still amazing as well. Lectures felt like a break from a long day of classes and studying because of how great they are. If you can take one of his classes, TAKE IT!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Andrews is by far my favorite professor at UNC. His lectures are unmatched and he is really fair with grades. There is a lot of reading but you don't need to do all of it. 2 Essays and a final which is not that much work. Recitation participation matters. Easy A class if you pay attention in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best professor I ever had. His lectures made the class seem to go by in 20 minutes because they were so interesting, engaging, and full of energy. He is extremely knowledgeable and has a gift of conveying information in a way that makes it entertaining. He is also great to talk to outside of class if you ever have questions or just want to chat.

Prof. Andrews is one of UNC's best professors. In addition to being an amazing lecturer and possessing an incredible knowledge of the curriculum, he is a very nice and accessible person. All of his classes are great regardless of size or topic, and I would absolutely recommend him to any student, even if you've never once watched a sporting event.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you are a basketball fan, take his class! Professor Andrews is very knowledgeable and passionate about the sport and gives insightful and thought provoking lectures. The class itself is a lot of work as it is based on 3 papers graded by a TA and reading 4 books throughout the semester for recitation.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Having now completed 8 semesters at UNC, I can confidently say Prof. Andrews is the best professor I have had here and this is the best class I have taken. As a basketball fan, the content is interesting and Prof. Andrews does an amazing job of explaining the racial dynamics behind the history of the sport. The books he assigns are amazing as well!

Matt Andrews is my favorite professor at UNC. He's an exceptional lecturer that makes his content fun and relevant. I do highly recommend taking his History of Basketball Class, HIST 585. It's not too difficult of course but is super interesting and does make you think a bit more than his Olympics class.

Do yourself a favor. Take a class with Matt Andrews during your time at UNC. Not only will it be one of the best classes you've ever taken, its interesting, not difficult, and hes amazing. I declared the history minor so I could keep taking the classes and know like 5 people who have done the same. Just trust me, if you're debating doing it, do it!

Dr. Andrews is probably the best teacher I've had at Carolina. His lectures are delivered so well it doesn't really seem like class , but instead story time with Matt twice a week. Dr. Andrews is always accessible and you can tell he really cares about his course subject and students. Would HIGHLY recommend taking at least one of his courses.

Top 5 teacher in my life. I'm doing a history minor now just because of Andrews. Interesting, funny lectures. The content is some of the best you'll find at UNC. There is a decent amount of reading and graded only on essays and short/easy quizzes. Only teacher that I've ever seen receive full applause on LDOC. Take any class you can with him.

Best professor at UNC hands down. I'm getting a history minor just to take all of his classes. His lectures are SO good and he makes class so interesting every time. He loves meeting people outside of class and is just overall such a cool guy. Class isn't technically mandatory but you need to go to pass biweekly quizzes and write the essays
Best professor of all time. Only graded on three papers and showing up to recitation. Very interesting material and pretty easy class

I don't have enough positive things to say about Dr. Andrews. He is brilliant, interesting, passionate and has a genuine love for teaching. Regardless of whether you like sports history, take a class with Dr. Andrews. He's the best lecturer I have ever had. Just to show how beloved he isattendance is optional, but the class was ALWAYS full.

Taking the Olympic Games class with Andrew Matthews was phenomenal. Can't say enough good things. Even with being online, his class was super interesting - I was constantly sharing things I learned with my friends. Highly recommend taking any class you can with him!

History 362- Baseball and American History, is by far my favorite class I've taken at Carolina. Dr. Andrews is awesome, and always provides great lectures and discussion points for each class. Highly recommend taking this, or any other course Dr. Andrews teaches. You won't be disappointed. The books/assigned readings are super manageable too.

This is my second class taken with Andrews and I will continue to take them until there are no other classes to take. He is an amazing professor who gives interesting lectures and if you put effort in you will easily get an A. Genuinely cares about his students and everyone should take a class with him!!

One of UNC's best professors! His basketball class was a MUST TAKE for any student. Andrews is a phenomenal lecturer and very knowledgeable about the subject. He gives great feedback and the class recitations are very interesting to help build off the class conversation. Three papers, some mini quizzes, and a final. Might be my favorite class here!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: AMAZING CLASS. Professor Andrews is so engaging and so kind and truly makes his lectures that entertaining. Just like everyone else said. Took 585 for US credit, I would've taken it for free.

I took Dr. Andrews class for my Gen Ed credit (I am not a history major). He is probably the best lecturer I have ever had, you should absolutely take his class. I am not super big into history, but he is so passionate and good at teaching that I really loved this class.

Professor Andrews is a great guy. Did not know I could learn even more about sports but he is just that great of a professor. Unfortunately, the grade you get is not dependent on him, but your TA, who grades 3 papers that consists of about 80% of your grade. But Andrews is always willing to help outside of class and provide aid when needed.

My second class taken with Andrews. Gives amazing lectures that are rarely boring. Majority of your grade comes from 2 papers and the final which were graded by TAs, but the TAs are typically really fair about grades. I cannot say enough nice things about Andrews and his classes. Take his classes if you can!!

I would take all my classes with Professor Andrews if I could. He is an amazing lecturer, and if you go to lecture and pay attention you will do well. He inspired me to think more deeply about the content, and sparked an interest in something that was supposed to be a class I didn't care about. Take a class with Prof Andrews!

Dr. Andrews is an amazing teacher. He's very accessible outside of class. I had incredible conversations with him in his office hours. His lectures were also incredible. Definitely learned a lot from this class. I will definitely take more classes with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Everyone loves Prof. Andrews. I finally took one of his classes and it's easy to see why. The lectures are actually super interesting- it's like sitting down and listening to sports trivia, but then you realize you're learning history too. Graded by 7 online quizzes, 2 papers, and a final. Easy A, and super enjoyable class.

Literally LOVE Andrews. He does an extremely good job making lecture material very interesting and ties it into such relevant, interesting topics. I'm hoping to take another class taught by him in the future. LOVE THIS CLASS. Grade is mostly papers, but they're pretty easy to write since the material is so interesting.
Prof. Andrews is the best. The lectures are amazing and he clearly loves what he teaches.

DR. ANDREWS IS THE BEST. His lectures are organized well and incredibly engaging, no matter the topic. 11/10 recommend. He is funny and caring, even asynchronously. Really awesome guy and course all around

Dr. Andrews is great. Most of the kids in my class are literally taking the class just because they've already had him and know they'll love whatever classes he teaches or they've heard about his reputation and want to take one of his classes. Engaging lectures, really awesome teacher. I highly recommend taking one of his classes.

He was very nice and interesting. I found him easy to pay attention to and he is an excellent lecturer. But he also discusses a lot of violent topics in HIST220 and he uses some really gruesome images in his presentations. He also assigned some rather graphic movies as homework. If you're squeamish or easily anxious, just be careful.
Dr. Andrews is a great lecturer, which is good because you have to attend every class to be prepared for the final. There are several papers throughout the semester that are graded by TAs.

History of Olympics with Professor Andrews is my favorite class that I have ever taken at UNC. His lectures are actually really interesting and he presents material very well. There is a quiz every week in recitation to make sure that you are attending lectures so if you don't go to class you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Andrews is my favorite professor so far at UNC. I decided to minor in history since he offers so many classes! He is so passionate about the material that you won't want to skip his lectures. The grading is solely based on the difficulty of your TA, so that is the only downside to his classes.

Andrews is the GOAT. There is never a boring lecture, and he is super kind, funny, and accessible outside class to talk history, sports, or both. However, your grade is HIGHLY dependent on your TA. If you write well, you will be fine; if not, go to the Writing Center for help on your papers. Overall, do not graduate from UNC without taking Andrews.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Andrews is the best professor at UNC. He is incredibly knowledgeable on everything he teaches. While attendance is not taken, you should go to every class because of how captivating Dr. Andrews' lectures are. A few papers, no midterm, and a final exam: the papers are graded harsh, but fair, so if you are a good writer you will be good.
One of the best professors I've had at UNC. His class is extremely interesting and he is super passionate. Highly recommend.

The best professor at UNC hands down. I am sad I only got to take one class with him. A lot of my friends would take every class he offered, even though they werent history majors. Intelligent, funny, interesting, not too much homework, interesting essay prompts.... my biggest regret at unc is not taking more classes with this gem of a human
Nothing to say that hasn't already been said. Professor Andrews is the best. I consistently get chills during his lectures.

This was my first Andrews class. The legends are true! Every lecture was a treat: in-depth, packed with pictures and videos, thought-provoking. No matter what you think you know about basketball, 585 will teach you countless new things. Essays and readings require some dedication, but no problem at all if you're a basketball lover. So worth taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My favorite prof at UNC hands down. Attendance is not mandatory but his lectures are so amazing that I WANT to go to his class. Your grade is off of two papers, a midterm, and a final so your grade is dependent on your TA. Andrews is hilarious and great to talk to outside of class. Even if you aren't interested in baseball TAKE THIS CLASS
andrews is a true gem. phenomenal class - but not as easy as everyone says. it all depends on your TA and if you have a harsh grader, it's most definitely not an easy A

He is the best of the best! It is totally worth it to take a class with him if you can. The lectures are very thoughtful and interesting. Reading isn't mandatory to pass but is very interesting. He really care about the students as well!

Easily one of my favorite professors at UNC and HIST 220 is my favorite class that I've taken at UNC! Really effective lecturer and makes you want to go to class. Covers everything that you need to know and explains it all very clearly. Highly recommend!

i cannot say enough good things about this man he is by far my favorite professor at unc. his lectures are so interesting and made me look forward to coming to class. dont have to read the textbook bc he covers the material even better in lecture. also kinda a dilf
Great lecturer. A lot of writing and reading but the lectures are always interesting. Cool course and learned a lot. Matthew Andrews is the man.

Andrews' lectures are always fun and engaging, and the material is super interesting. There were three papers, three history digs (short 1-2 page writing assignments), short quizzes (lowest dropped), recitation and the final (Olympic locations/years, IDs and an essay). Grades are very dependent on your TA, but would definitely recommend Andrews!!

He is easily one of my favorite professors I've ever had. He always makes time for questions during lectures. Class isn't mandatory but if you don't come you'll miss out on a lot. His lectures will tell you everything you need to know. He tells great stories about Olympic athletes while also telling you about history. I really enjoyed this class!
Best professor at UNC.

By far the best history professor at UNC. Maybe even the best professor outright. He does a great job of making lectures easy to follow by forming them around stories about historical events and figures. As someone who has sat through numerous verbose and boring history lectures, trust me when I say Dr. Andrews is the BEST.

Professor Andrews is most definitely the best professor at UNC-CH. He is an amazing lecturer and there was never a dull moment during his class. Would recommend to anyone interested in sports or history but would also recommend to anyone who wishes to have a genuine professor. Class is moderately hard because of TAs grading and expect to read.

Andrews  best history professor I've ever had. He's hilarious. Never a dull moment during his lectures. It honestly all comes down to your TA since they grade your work. There was a lot of writing involved in this course, but the material is not hard to follow. Quizzes based on lecture, which is usually every other week. HIGHLY recommend.

My favorite class last semester. He doesn't take attendance but his lectures are so interesting and entertaining I wanted to go to every one. Grades are based off two papers and the finals. So if you have an easy TA it's an easy A.

Professor Andrew is wonderful! His lectures are hilarious and super informative. He does a great job of giving us all of the facts and allowing us to form our OWN opinions. My T.A was great, but I have heard this wasn't the case for the other ones. T.A's grade EVERYTHING so it may or may not be an easy A for your specific T.A. GREAT COURSE!

Professor Andrews has by far been my favorite professor I've had at UNC. He is so passionate about sports history and he tells his lectures like stories which make students come to class even though attendance is not mandatory. However, your grade is solely dependent on your TA so hope you get a good one! 100% recommend taking this class!!!

He's a really great lecturer and makes sports history (something I really don't care about) seem pretty interesting. Not a lot of work during the semester and you don't have to do the reading if you go to class. Your grade does depend on your TA though.

As someone who wasn't really into sports, Professor Andrews is really fun and a truly engaging lecturer who made the history surrounding sports really interesting to learn! There is recitation every other week with a pretty easy quiz. Only downfall of the class is that there are only a few graded assignments and the TA's are pretty tough graders.

Like most of these reviews say, Andrews is an amazing lecturer. He makes the topics at hand very interesting and I was never bored. The course is tough, however, as it's entirely dependent on tough-grading TAs. The final also kind of was a monster to get through. 2 papers; final with short answer, short essay, and long essay; quiz every recitation
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I was extremely hesitant going into sports history as a person who is not interested in neither history or sports but Andrews made every lecture extremely interesting and engaging. Essays are heavily weighted so if you're not the best writer, I would not recommend. If you pay attention in lecture, you will do well in quizzes in recitation!

Probably the only professor that could make history engaging for me. Super funny and tries to tell a story instead of simply lecturing. Cares about if you are learning and understanding the material. Your grade is dependent on TA's like most history classes however.
Dr. Andrews is an amazing lecturer, never boring. Class is reasonably paced, he often stops to take questions and makes sure no one is lost. These are all very important in a lecture heavy class.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Andrews is a great guy! Interesting class taught by the highs and the lows of American History. Two essays, One Final, Quizzes every recitation. 10/10 Recommend!!

Dr. Andrews is one of the best lecturers at UNC. The material he teaches on makes it easy, but he always keeps you interested. However, I rated him as 4 toughness because your grade is highly dependent on TA. Mine was great but was a tough grader on the papers and the final. Absolutely take classes with Andrews, they are slightly difficult but fun.

Dr. Andrews is incredible, the best lecturer at UNC hands-down. He's so passionate about all things history and loves interacting with his students both during and after class. Absolutely take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This was my fourth class with Dr. Andrews.  Enjoyed going to class everyday.  HIST220 was History of the Olympic Games - his first time teaching the subject and I thought he did a fantastic job.  Likewise, I had an excellent TA, which made my experience even better than I could have expected.  Any class you find with Andrews, TAKE IT.

Dr. Andrews was my favorite professor my first semester at UNC! His lectures are engaging and have a clear outline. I am not a history person, but I looked forward to going to his class! He stops several times during lecture to ask for questions. He is genuinely passionate about the subjects he is teaching and is a super smart guy!

I took this class with Dr. Andrews last semester, and I think it is still by far my favorite class that I have taken at UNC. He makes his history lectures into an amazing story about the past that keeps your attention. I thoroughly enjoyed going to class, and I definitely will take another one of his classes if I'm given the chance.
Amazing lecturer. Would definitely take again!

Professor Andrews is honestly my favorite professor at UNC. He clearly outlines what is expected in the syllabus. You have three papers and an essay final- all graded by TA's. However, if you make an effort and go to the TA's office hours you should be fine. Andrews is a fantastic lecturer and I will definitely be taking another one of his courses!
Dr. Andrews is THE BEST professor at UNC! If you don't take at least one of his classes you are wasting your tuition!

Awesome lectures, fun person! Its a great class, 3 papers and then the final. Also short (and easy) quizzes in recitations, which do not happen every week.  The TA's grade everything so I guess your grade depends on them more then him. But they all seam to not grade really hard. Deff would recommend 110%

Professor Andrews is the best professor I have ever had. His lectures were so inspirational and interesting that I am now considering a history minor. We had three papers, some reading for homework, and a final; not bad at all. This class was the highlight of my semester. Oh, and he is super hot too, which makes lecture even better.

Dr. Andrews is one the best teachers/ professors I have ever had. You will no doubt enjoy the class (his lectures are always awesome) even if the material doesn't seem that interesting to you. The best class I've taken at UNC and the most fun I've had listening to a lecture. If you can take a class w/ Dr. Andrews, TAKE IT!!

Dr. Andrews is THE best lecturer at UNC, hands down. However, all essays are graded by TA's, which is always subjective. His class was definitely the highlight of my semester though, and I'll definitely be taking another of his classes. Genuinely great guy
He's a good guy and his lectures are interesting, but your grade completely depends on what TA you get so good luck there.

I think the other reviews sum up Matt Andrew's classes pretty well. His lectures are absolutely phenomenal, he's a down to earth guy who is willing to help if you need it, and his class is super interesting. The TAs grade everything which was sort of hit or miss.

Dr. Andrews is a fantastic professor and made my first semester at UNC a much more positive experience. His lectures are well-planned, clear, and he stops and pauses multiple times to get questions/comments from the class. I decided to minor in history because of this class (128). If you get the chance, definitely take any of his classes.

Dr. Andrews is honestly the best professor I have had at UNC. His lectures are so interesting that I don't even feel the time pass. Even though the class is huge, he encourages participation and questions. He is also super helpful during office hours. I would highly recommend that you take his class before you leave UNC!
I LOVED Professor Andrews. He is the best professor I've had at UNC and an amazing person. Plus, he's not that bad to look at during class. He's super personable and dreamy.
He's awesome, engaging, and funny. The class was interesting and fairly easy!
THE BEST professor I have ever had.  His lectures are engaging and it is always easy to pay attention.

Andrews is by far my favorite professor at UNC. His class is well structured and his lectures have an easy to follow outline. He assigns an average amount of reading for a History course, but all the reading is super interesting. Will take again for sure!

This is the second class I have taken with him. He is a great lecturer, and keeps it interesting. However, all of the grading is up to the TAs, and they can be VERY tough graders. He is a great guy, but don't expect great grades.  I didn't use the textbook.
By far the best lecturer at UNC. I would take any class with him.

The TAs did all the grading (2 papers, recitation, final) but Andrews' lecture were awesome. I always enjoyed the class because it was fun and he kept it interesting. He really knows his stuff and asks repeatedly if anyone has any questions. Best lecturer I've had.
Dr. Andrews is amazing. He makes class fun and interesting. He's super engaging and really passionate about the subject. If you have the chance to take a class with him, DO IT!
Take any class you can with him!!

This was the third class that I had taken with Andrews and it was just as good as the previous two.  Great professor, consistently keeping his students engaged.  I spent much of this semester talking to him in his office about course content and it was very rewarding.  He gives good feedback and loves to converse with students.  Must take class!
andrews is the man i really want to take more of his classes

Very good lecturer, class was very engaging and informative. Even if you are not a big history fan his lectures will keep you interested. Kept class interesting by encouraging discussions and showing videos. Tests and papers were straightforward, but reading was necessary.

A really great professor. If I could take another class with him, I'd do so immediately. He's very generous, his class isn't too difficult (2 essays and a final-- very fair), and he's quite a knowledgeable man.  Above all, his lectures are inspirational, fantastic, amazing, etc. I'd definitely recommend him as a professor. He's one of the best.

Dr. Andrews is an incredible lecturer. He always kept class very interesting, and I looked forward to attending class (even though I don't usually like history). He is a really great professor, and you won't regret taking any of his classes. Everyone in my class clapped for him on the last day of class; he is definitely respected by his students.

All of the grading is done by your TA, but I really enjoyed his lectures. I have never really been a fan of history, but his lectures were enjoyable and I learned a lot. I would definitely take another class with him.

Just like all of these reviews say- he's wonderful. HOWEVER---- his TAs are incredibly hard graders and ruined my GPA. I was knowledgeable of the material, and can write english essays well, but was ultimately screwed over because the TA did not like my style as I was not used to writing history essays.

Professor Andrews was my favorite professor I've ever had. I view history in a totally new light because of his amazing lectures; he tells history from such a unique, insightful perspective. I truly looked forward to his class. His TA's were great, but hard graders. I plan to take many more of Professor Andrews' classes. DEFINITELY take him!

Dr. Andrews is great! His lectures are very clear and interesting. The grading comes from two big papers, the final and participation from the recitation. Attendance is not necessary if you'd rather  just read all of the book (just go to class).  Would definitely recommend you take any history course available with him!

Sport and American History with Andrews was a great class with an entirely new outlook on the effect of sports regarding America's evolution. Andrews is a great lecturer and will help you out whenever you need it!  TA's are a different story unfortunately.  If you luck out with your TA, you'll love this class!

Great lectures. Felt really engaged in class. Andrews loved what he was teaching. He was also funny at times. The books he assigns are interesting to read, though some are a little long. The essay topics are rather broad which can be helpful and are not too hard. Attendance was not mandatory but class is interesting enough to keep you attending.

Prof. Andrews is a very gifted lecturer.  Presents history as an interesting story, tying everything together rather than just presenting a bunch of facts and dates.  Attendance is vital to success.  Very approachable, humble guy. Two big papers each worth 25% of your grade.  The TAs grade these fairly tough, so take seriously.   Definitely rec.

Andrews is such a great teacher.  He does his lectures in a way that make it so easy to take good clear notes and he has a great balance of humor and seriousness. You learn a lot in his course and I am not sure I will take a better course in college than his Sports and American History class.  If you can get a class with Andrews, take it.
Interesting lectures, not too much homework

Andrews was a really cool professor. Be prepared to be taught history from an angle you're probably not used to. He focuses less on the battles and political events and more on how history affects people. Very interesting class, awesome guy that knows how to keep students engaged.

Greatest professor I have ever had.  Phenomenally motivated to teach students and lectures the course content extraordinarily well.  Very funny, personable, and learned.  If you can, take EVERY History class with Dr. Andrews.  Looks Great! Sounds Great! Can't lose!
Literally one of the best teachers I've had at UNC! His lectures are really interesting even if you don't like history (and he's definitely not bad to look at) I took him for 128 and 140

Feel so grateful to meet Dr. Andrews and the class for my first year in UNC. He is knowledgeable, and also his presentation is engaging. You don't even need to read the textbook if you can go to every class. Grade is very straightforward and is not hard to get an A. Only two essays and one final. Easy+fun.

Literally one of the best professors I have had at UNC Chapel Hill. His lectures are so engaging, and he really cares about his students understanding the material. I know people who aren't even enrolled in the class but come to lectures just to listen. I took his 128 class, and now I am in 140. Take him for any history class you can!

One of the best teachers I've had at Carolina, he's a really great lecturer and as long as you take a lot of notes and work hard on the essays, you should do fine. I liked his class so much that I'm taking another one of his next semester.

Extremely interesting and funny. Very open to opinions that contradict his own and actually encourages students to share diverging viewpoints. Makes it easy/not awkward to participate in a large lecture class. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but I genuinely wanted to go to class. A very interesting lecturer. Be sure to take lots of notes.
This class and Dr. Andrews were two of the best things that happened to my college career.

Very good lecturer, really engages and cares about the material, and wants his class to understand it. Makes the material seem very interesting and important. The grading is very straightforward and fair.
Such a great professor!! I highly recommend his class. He knew what he was talking about and engaged us in his lectures. He's also really good looking ;)
Very engaging lecturer and really knows his stuff.
Dr. Andrews is one of the best history instructors I have ever encountered. He makes everything interesting and is extremely engaging and knowledgeable in his field.
Great Professor.  Would definitely recommend taking any one of his classes

I am not interested in history at all and at first dreaded having to fill a history class, but Professor Andrews makes it fun, interesting, and relevant. I loved how he picked out fun stuff from history to talk about. Some of the readings were uninteresting, but overall it was a GREAT course and highly recommended.

Amazing teacher.  Very aware of the students he is teaching and engages everyone with a respectful peer like demeanor.  Great lectures that really present a story that is worth while.  Didn't miss a class though attendance was not mandatory.  Very helpful and understanding.
He is very kind and keeps content interesting and upbeat.  He is a fair grader.

Professor Andrews' lectures are interesting and well organized. TA's graded everything in my class so make sure you go to recitation with something to say. Great class to take for history requirement!
Without a doubt the best professor I've had at UNC.  Lectures are entertaining and fun, but also full of good information.  Matt is super helpful.  Very highly recommended.

Prof Andrews is a great teacher! The class is a very low maintenance kind of class.  Though it is a lecture, and attendance is not required, I don't mind going to class every time. There is minimal homework and an average amount of reading. I def. recommend him to anyone!

He teaches in a caring manner where he emphasizes and separates history into different categories which helps better in the learning process. Every other week you have to write a short, easy essay based on articles, but it's not big deal.  The tests are all short answer or essay but he gave the terms/essay question before the tests.
Matt is an incredibly engaging and creative teacher. He gives students insight into the lives of lesser known historical figures in a way that reshapes our understanding of history.
Matt is awesome! Makes the class really really interesting.  This was the only class that I didn't skip.  Loves teaching and is very very helpful. I would recommend taking anything he teaches!

Matt is a great professor. He has a passion for history and wants to get his students involved. He is always available to talk to if you need help. He tries to keep his class engaged by bringing music/photos into his lectures.
Absolutely amazing professor! Makes lectures very interesting.  Class is more of a conversation. Tests are sorta easy if you pay attention in class.  I would definitely recommend taking his course!

Tony is great! Lectures were engaging, good amount of info on slides but not too much. Exams were mostly vocab-based with some application questions. Homeworks were easy and the TA helped out a ton! A good amount of reading, but he goes over the important stuff in classes so attendance is a good idea. Great class and great material

Tony is an extremely nice and genuine guy and I could have done much better if I would have paid more attention and studied harder. Grading is only on two midterms, a final, and weekly homeworks but the homework is a small chunk. Found the lectures very, very information heavy and hard to pay attention to and exams hard to study for.

Super enthusiastic about marine science. Presentations are pretty good, although not always great for individual review. Homeworks are weekly but don't take up much time each week. He can be a little disorganized, but nothing bad.

Textbook chapters are incredibly long and you likely won't have time to read all of them. Two midterms, a final, and homeworks are the grades in this class, and if you stumble once it's over because you need a 95 to get an A. Tony's a nice guy and the material isn't complex, but I wouldn't recommend for just a focus capacity.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tony is one of the sweetest human beings alive. He genuinely cares about each one of his students. I was not super interested in sed strat at first, but his excitement and teaching made me enjoy the class way more than I thought I would. I wish he taught more classes b/c I would 100% take another class with him.

Tony is the man. He definitely knows his stuff, and he is pretty enjoyable to listen to. He is also really funny, so that helps. The class is difficult, but not impossible. He clearly states what is expected of you, and he also has very clear expectations of tests.

Professor Snowden is great! Made the class really fun and entertaining. Definitely need to enjoy theatre to some extent to take this class. Sometimes lectures weren't the most entertaining, but it was fun getting to read the plays and dissect them afterwards. A lot of group work was involved. Overall a good class, great for a focus capacity.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Class was alright, some of the plays we had to see in person were somewhat interesting but overall not too fun of a class. You could tell Snowden felt that her students didn't seem to care too much about her class and she combatted this with 8 mandatory attendance checks which were annoying.

Tons of assignments and can get unlucky with TA grading. Snowden is a knowledgeable professor who loves drama but makes the class difficult. Wouldn't recommend that highly for a focus capacity anymore.

Take DRAM 116 for a focus capacity. Class often ended early, assignments are easy worst part is reading the plays. Graded on attendance, midterm and final (both take home), in class group assignments, and quizzes on plays. Extra credit opportunities. Beware won't round your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is a breeze if you put in some effort. Attendance is mandatory, but the workload is light - just weekly reading quizzes and a few papers. Unstuck study was super helpful for prepping for the exams. Overall, an easy A.

Some of the lectures were interesting while others were not at all. Grading is mostly chill except for one review paper, which was heavily weighted and mine was graded by a pretty rude TA that dropped my grade a good bit. There is some group work for attendance that sucks. You have to buy many extra books but you don't really need the textbook.

I wouldn't call the class an easy A, mostly because your grade is HEAVILY dependent on your TA. Some are fine, but others are extremely stingy. The paper was graded harshly, but most of the other assignments weren't too difficult.

Don't listen to these other reviews…people are just lazy. Do the work, you'll get an A. Snowden clearly marks when you need to come to class on the syllabus which is nice. You have to see a few plays at Playmakers. She clearly cares a lot about the course material and is easily reachable after class/by email.

Should be an easy A or A- for any student at UNC. Never went to class other than the few mandatory days. Had to go to a play outside of class which sucked, but other than that, it was chill. Didn't interact with her too much because I was never in class, but when I did she seemed nice. Lots of athletes in there, so you know that is a good sign.

I am writing this as I wait for this class to start (late, as per usual). The papers are graded harshly, the lectures are super duper boring, there is no point in taking this class unless you hate yourself. Seriously trust me on this. (I did get an A though, I just hated it the entire time. Warning, wasn't easy though.)

The class was easy, but Professor Snowden was rude. Reached out to my TA about grades but Professor Snowden went through one of my assignments, left rude comments about what I did wrong, then emailed me back and say my TA was "generous" in grading it. Both the TA and prof held a grudge against me when grading my remaining assignments in the class.

Snowden is so fun and very passionate about drama! The class has a give or take 1 play a week to read, but they are short. There are a few group assignments to be present for, otherwise attendance is optional. You have to attend 2 plays and write only a few papers, otherwise the class is laid back and an easy pass as long as you keep up with notes.

This class was super easy.  If you do all of the assignments with even the smallest amount of effort, you'll get an A.  You must come to class to do the participation assignments and you must see three plays at playmakers throughout the semester.

This class is extremely easy, but also enjoyable. Super light workload, tons of athletes. Simple reading quizzes every week, no need to read in depth (ctrl F will do the job if needed), one paper, multiple choice online final exam, have to go see 3 plays but they are usually really good and fun to watch, it's easy to not miss attendance days.
SO BAD PROFESSOR, DO NOT TAKE HER COURSE ANY MORE!

You dont rlly have to go to class but there are a few participation things that if you miss your grade will drop significantly. Grading depends on your TA. The TA Jack Roark grades extremely harshly on papers and will not accept regrade requests. I wouldn't take another drama class instead.
she was fine and i got a decent grade but if u miss one participation assignment ur grade will tank significantly

Easiest class I have ever taken at UNC. Barely had any homework, just a weekly quiz about a reading, a couple papers, but the grading is super chill. There is the occasional participation grade, but she usually announces when they will be, just show up for that day. Snowden is very chill, I recommend this class.
Snowden was an awful teacher. She did not care at all about her students. This class seemed like a class she was forced to teach.

Snowden herself was kind of annoying, can be really condescending and rude to her students and is definitely an adult theater kid. Class was pretty easy, I didn't read the plays and some summaries were not easily found online so thats the reason for the B+. Overall, if theater is your vibe then it is a cool class, if not I'd steer clear.

Be ready to read a lot of plays just to take a 10 question quiz that can be easily done by reading sparknotes. She is not lenient at extensions at all and will combine assignments/change assignment names in canvas so triple check what you submit. Also requires attending plays outside of class which costed $10 each. I never used the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: clearly very passionate about the material, which is kind of sad in a class where most students seem to not really care. participation/talking to her before/after class goes a long way. there were some mix-ups with the grading/TAs this year, but she fixed it after I asked abt it. u have to see 2 plays outside of class, but student tickets are cheap
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: SO EASY! I actually do not think anyone got less than an A. Be prepared though, you CANNOT skip class or she will take -5 off your final grade. Also many times you don't know what you're supposed to be doing (I played Google Snake for like 90% of class) but she'll give you a 100% anyway. You have to see and read a few plays but nothing hard

Snowden was very disrespectful and rude to her students. Snowden made it almost unbearable to attend class because would always target specific students during lecture to be condescending and rude to. Professor is AWFUL but the class was a joke it was so easy.

She's a great professor, but beware, doesn't care about your emails. She grades based mostly on completion, so try somewhat in class, but no need to go overboard. Be there, or you won't pass, even if you're sick, frankly she doesn't really care that much unless you're dying, take a dayquil. I loved this class though, would take it again.
She is an awesome professor! I came into this class with no prior theater experience, but thoroughly enjoyed this class and learning about documentary theater. Take this class if you can!

I have had Aubrey for DRAM116 and DRAM300. She is extremely passionate about what she does and you can tell in her lectures, assignment choices, etc. Snowden definitely is a "tough love" kind of person and can be dry or perceived as rude at times, but she really does care. As long as you pay attention and do the work, you'll be fine.
The goat.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy gen ed credit. Lots of extra credit. Almost no out of class work other than paper and seeing a couple plays.

Not a very interesting class but easy to fulfill gen ed requirement but there's definitely other better classes to take. You do get out early almost every class and the papers are pretty easy but depends on the TA. There are extra credit opportunities if you need them, midterm and final are easy.

TAKE THIS FOR GEN ED REQ. Super easy, I didn't always read the plays & got by. Takes pollev attendance randomly so you have to pay attention for that. 2 papers (very easy). Midterm & final were online & super easy. Take this class for an easy A. Some plays are super fun to watch, some aren't personal pref.
Weird grading and totally dependent on TAs. Literally submit a wrong sentence and u get a 0. Easy class but there are easier ones. She is accessible though, and will help you out if you are kind
This class is a very easy fc fulfillment. The class itself was slightly boring, however, it was VERY easy. She would often start class late but would also often let us leave extremely early.
This class is really easy as long as you pay attention even at a moderate level. Be prepared that you will need to read a lot of full plays.

take an easier gen ed if you can but If you're stuck in this one just try and you will be fine. weekly quizzes on different plays, a couple of papers, and midterm and final. attendance is once a week with poll ev. (idk why but this class stressed me out for no reason.)

If you need an easy-ish class to complement your schedule, TAKE THIS CLASS. It's not difficult. You have to write 2 2-3 page papers and weekly quizzes, but it's not hard. The quizzes + midterm + final are online and you can take them at home.

This class is actually so easy. You have to see 2-3 in person plays over the semester but they are not bad, and you have to write like a two page paper for them also which is not bad either. Her TA sometimes grade tough but other than that its easy and she offers extra credit throughout the semester

She was very nice, but the class had a quiz due weekly that are typically posted the night before. On top of this you have plays to see plays with worksheets, a midterm, papers, and a final. None of these things are necessarily hard just more time consuming than you would think. ATTENDANCE IS PART OF YOUR GRADE.
Very easy class but also a waste of time. Beware of Snowden's attitude as well
Fairly easy course, lectures also tended to end much earlier than the scheduled end of class. 2 short papers but they weren't very difficult.

Definitely recommend Prof. Snowden! She taught the material in a fun way and quizzes/exams were never too hard at all. She sometimes speeds through class PowerPoints, but always posts them afterwards incase you couldn't take note of everything during class.

She cares about what she teaches and makes it fun. She knows people take it for credit and offers clear grading criteria, I got 100s on both papers by following it. Open note online midterm and final. You do have to see 3 performances but not bad. Weekly quizzes but only 8-10 questions. Would recommend for VP credit!

This was a good gen-ed. You will do well if you take notes from her PowerPoints. There are weekly quizzes that are not hard if you read the plays. Midterm and final were multiple choice and there were two papers that were very doable. You have to attend around three performances at Playmakers. She rarely kept us for more than 30 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Snowden is a great professor! The plays we watched were good, but the lectures are boring. Aubrey is somewhat snarky at times when she's had coffee, but the class is easy, and great for busy STEM majors who need easy Gen-eds for GPA inflation. The main things that contribute to your grade are two papers, quizzes, a midterm, and a final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easy weekly quizzes on the plot of the plays we read and 2 papers that were pretty easy, but the best part of this class was the 50 minute lectures were hardly ever longer than 30-35 minutes. The lectures are boring, but worth it for an extremely easy class.

The course was okay. I enjoyed all the plays we had to watch and I liked some of the plays we read. I would have liked more feedback on quizzes/assignments. I don't think she's a great lecturer. I found it hard to stay engaged. I would write Powerpoint notes after class since she moves through slides at a fast pace. I recommend a different gen-ed.

Super easy gen ed. There are 2 papers that are not difficult. Short and simple weekly quizzes. Attendance is taken once a week. Must attend 3 plays. Everything on midterms/finals are straight from lecture slides and the plays you read. Prof Snowden wasn't the best for a few reasons, but class was easy and not time consuming so no complaints.

Honestly this was a really easy gen ed. you will do really well in the class if you simply take notes (which she always posts the slides so you can look back) the TAs also graded leniently. All the midterm & final questions (online exams from home) came straight from the notes. You do have to attend 3 plays in person and read a bunch, but it's easy

hard gen ed reading heavy with a quiz on a different quiz every week. hard grader on papers and boring lectures. took a long time releasing grades and never released quiz answers to help prepare for the exams. also, prof is not the nicest person especially interacting with her students. would not take again. way better aesthetics gen eds out there.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is easy but you have to put in effort to get an A. Lots of readings but are easy to read and interesting most of the time. Midterm/final are online and simple if you read the play's and go to class. She is actually very kind and understanding just talk to her about whatever you are struggling with. I learned a lot!

Play analysis is so easy if you pay attention in class anyone on here complaining that this class was awful most likely didn't. Prof is unorganized at times but she's incredibly understanding. Just talk to her after class if ur having a hard time with HW. It's a good amount of reading but one activity a week and open note/book final and midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: god I hate this class, and you probably will too. an easy A but annoying af. pick your poison ig
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The material itself isn't difficult, just make sure you like drama. My biggest complaint is that she is extremely disorganized.  She releases assignments the day before they are due and without proper instruction.   Additionally, she rarely releases grades.  The few grades I do have took at least a month to get.  Overall, an unpleasant experience.

attendance 20%, participation 20%, assignments 20%, midterm 20%, final project 20%. class is an easy A if you try and talk a decent amount in class, but she is very disorganized and annoying. she releases assignments 2 days before they are due and has unclear instructions, but she grades easy as long as it looks like you tried. midterm is open note

Professor Snowden is not a difficult teacher but can be frustrating. She is often extremely rude in class and is not easily accessible to students. Weekly quizzes, Midterms, and Papers were easy but are a lot for a Gen Ed credit. She only takes attendance once a week but it is often on Fridays. Take for easy credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was made hard for absolutely no reason. For a simple gen ed, I would never take this class again. No feedback was ever given for quizzes or tests or midterms and the students were left guessing when it came to exams.

The class is extremely easy and is filled to the brim with UNC athletes (which says a-lot). Professor Snowden however is by far the rudest and most condescending professor I've ever had at UNC. Still worth taking the class due to its' low level of difficulty but beware.

This class is an easy A, but since it's drama the work is annoying. There's a weekly quiz that's easy if you read the play. There's a textbook, but you don't have to read it. The midterm and final are online and easy. There are 2 papers based on plays you have to see, but it's not hard. There's extra credit and she takes attendance once a week.
Professor Snowden was a little unorganized/unclear sometimes, but overall this was a super easy and interesting gen ed course!

Professor Snowden will not accommodate you for any reason without university excused absences or explicit instruction from ARS to do so. This class is not hard at all, but can get tedious, especially if you don't care about theater. I found myself skipping it as often as I could, the lectures were uninteresting. A lot of athletes take this course.

shes not good or bad to be honest. class is very easy (lots of student athletes) and guidelines are relatively clear except for final project which can be a bit confusing. can sometimes snap at students but its really not that bad, def an easy A

I took this class online and it was pretty straightforward. You read plays, usually take a quiz on it, and there were a few papers scattered around the course. Lectures are posted and I didn't watch them until class to exams. You don't need to pay for plays, just look for them online. From the reviews below, take it online and it's a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took this course online and it was a breeze! I didn't have much contact with Professor Snowden, but from what I saw she's not terrible. The class was pretty easy, there was a weekly poll question, plays to read, writing assignments, and quizzes. I probably read like half the plays, watched the recorded lectures, and still secured an A.

I don't understand why all these ratings are negative. Throughout the entire class, I did not see her give attitude or be mean to any students. She encouraged students to participate but rarely called on someone who didn't have their hand raised. She is an easy grader and I would definitely take this class again for VP credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Take this class for the VP credit. Your only homework is to read a play once a week and there were 2 papers which had clear expectations and were graded very easily. She gives a bit of extra credit. The final and midterm were both taken online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class really isn't difficult. the lectures can be boring if you aren't interested in theater but most of your grade will come from quizzes, tests, and a couple of papers that are not harshly graded. I would recommend taking the class with a friend for the gen ed requirement, and it should be easy. Also a lot of athletes take this class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Fairly easy class with leniently graded papers, however, Professor Snowden is not always the easiest to talk to about issues with the course. Attendance polls are inconsistent throughout the semester.

A play to read every week, a quiz from the play every week (do not buy the plays, get them on Z-Library or just read spark notes). 3 papers (she's not a tough grader). Attendance is a grade. The lectures are "okay" some are boring, some are not. Your final paper is based on a play you will see in person. She's not helpful during office hours.

TAKE THIS CLASS! I am not sure how people don't get A's. Snowden makes the class easy, grades papers extremely easy, and gives out extra credit. I have gotten a 100 on every paper and put no more than 2 hours into each one. If you do the work, you will get an A (it's as simple as that). So so easy I cannot recommend this class enough.

I would not recommend taking this class with Aubrey Snowden. Even with it being an asynchronous class, she was very rude in many of her emails and conversations with her students. Our learning was not prioritized and she put very little effort into our class.

I loved professor Snowden! Don't listen to the bad reviews, she was a fun lecturer and made class fun. You had to read one play every week and most were enjoyable. They could also be easily spark noted if needed. There were a few papers that weren't graded harshly. Overall loved the class and it was a pretty easy A.

Not sure why there are so many negative ratings? Snowden made this class so easy and picked interesting plays to read + watch. She's always super positive and excited to hear students' opinions/thoughts. She cares about what she teaches which makes the course fun. Readings/assignments can easily be done using SparkNotes and tests were easy!

the only way I would recommend this is if you're taking it asynchronously and don't have to interact with the professor. Simple questions are responded to extremely rudely. I can tell a lot of other reviews had this same experience. Never experienced such a condescending professor. Im sure you can find a better easy A class than this one.

Prof Snowden was great! She assigns lots of plays to read but almost all of them have a litcharts page that tells you everything you need to know without having to read the whole thing. Quizzes and tests are pretty easy and often have repeat questions. The group project was kind of annoying because we couldn't pick our groups, but still not hard!

Please dont be discouraged by the bad ratings on here! Aubrey started teaching only a couple of years ago because shes been working as an incredible and accomplished director- you will learn so much from her!! And shes gotten a much better grip on the teaching part- take her class! I LOVED IT
She is a great prof! Loved her
easy A. a really good professor if youre interested in theatre.

Professor Snowden rocks! I think she gets really put down by ratings because a lot of people taking the class arent there because they want to learn about theatre. The class is some readings about plays and if thats not your thing you wont enjoy it so dont take it out on the professor if you arent interested in the class.
If you want to be a thespian, take a class with this woman!

Although this class isn't hard, Professor Snowden is not a good teacher. On multiple occasions, she snapped at students for asking simple questions, and once stopped a student mid-presentation to yell at them. As long as you skim the readings (or look up a summary) you should be good. The group project at the end of the year can be frustrating.

Aubrey's class was life changing! She challenged me on the daily and made me into a better drama student. I owe her so much for keeping us motivated mid-pandemic! If you take this class, you won't regret it. Get ready to learn.

Easy A, but Professor Snowden is just not nice. She is rude to students when questions are asked. Unclear in what is expected for this class. Group project was frustrating being on zoom and had no idea what was expected of us. I had kids in other countries in my group and she did not care. Class is easy if you put in a little effort, easy online.

She is so disorganized that understanding what's expected of you in this class is hard. She snapped at students several times during the semester for asking questions she deemed stupid, and rather than making theatre enjoyable or accessible to others, she always spoke with an air of condescension and never explained anything. Take something else!!!

This class was one of the easiest classes I have taken at UNC, however her grading criteria is very unfair. The final was worth 35% of the grade and it was out of 50 points, 18 points was a 9 question multiple choice and the remaining 32 was an essay. That means that if you get 1 question wrong on the multiple choice youre already getting 96%.

This class was fine. There were a decent amount of plays to read and weekly quizzes, but nothing that took more than an hour to grind out. Keep up with the readings and show up to synchronous class once a week and you're fine. Sometimes directions were confusing but just took extra communication for clarity. Participate to help yourself stand out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She always held herself higher than others and that air came off of her whether she was being rude or not. The only problem I have with the class is how disorganized it is- the syllabus says one thing and then she does another and doesn't bother changing the syllabus either. Her final project was also extremely confusing to understand.

The UNC Chem department cares more about their students than Prof. Snowden, and that's saying something. She beats up students when they ask for clarification, harshly critiques student work in front of the class, and seems to feel the need to be above everyone else. She offloads most of project grading to her poor TAs too. Just take someone else.

Professor Snowden is completely uncaring about her students and situations that might arise given now everything is online. Communication is difficult as she doesn't always respond to emails. Her lectures are boring and the expectations for the class are unclear. If you can, avoid taking this class at all costs; it is stress that no one needs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: She's very condescending and makes it seem as though everybody owes something to her. Type of person to be rude to her students for no reason. NEVER responds to emails, you have to email her many times to get a single response. Wouldn't recommend as a prof, even though the class itself was pretty easy to do well in. Just overall very annoying class

Professor Snowden is rude and uncaring. She was often late to lecture and legitimately just reads off the slides. There were several pop quizzes on the readings that had such specific questions it was inevitable few would get them right. She called out students and often came off as annoyed. The class was boring too. Take something else!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is being very disrespected by a lot of these ratings. She is an easy teacher and her class is not too hard. There's a lot of reading, but you can Google a summary and ace every test. The lectures can be dry but this class opened my eyes up to theater. I loved watching the plays and would have never had watch them if this class wasn't a GenEd
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Snowden believes that everyone in DRAM 116 should be as passionate about the theater as she is. As such, she gets visibly annoyed with students talk out in her class or don't know the answers to assignments. Not extremely hard, just a very tedious teacher. Be prepared to go to multiple plays throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Sometimes wasn't the most clear on her lectures and the final group project can be a real pain if you don't get put with good group members. Study guides for exams weren't very specific, but overall, if you come to class and don't miss attendance and do well on the quizzes and see the plays, it's a fairly easy class.

I like theater, but I hated this class. The readings were long and frequent, the textbook was pretentious and had numerous spelling and grammar errors. The icing on the cake was having a group project in an intro class full of uninterested students. She also wasted my time calling out talking students in class instead of just continuing her lecture

I was worried about this class based off what the previous students said, but it was not even close to as bad. We fortunately didn't have pop quizzes and the final wasn't cumulative so it covered only the easier end to the semester info. Plentiful extra credit that you should do! But I can agree with the people below that she can be rude at times.

this class was pretty awful. So boring and the midterm and final exam are unnecessarily hard. She just kind of runs through the powerpoints; there is no "teaching" involved. I think she tries to blame it on everyone for not paying attention/engaging, but the reading is stupid long (for no reason) and she doesn't even attempt to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class was a terrible experience. A large percentage of the class grade is based on "participation" of what she said would be a daily poll everywhere question but instead it was based on two pop quizzes taken in the last two weeks of class. She claims the study guides contain the exam material but it was completely different.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've had at UNC. She does not make any of her powerpoints or tests and does not show up on test day. Students are given lengthy reading assignments and quizzes weekly. She gives unnecessary pop quizzes on extremely specific things that hurt the majority of the students. She's often rude to students and doesn't care about our success
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Snowden is one of the worst professors I've had at UNC. She just straight up reads from powerpoints that she didn't even make. You could skip lecture if not for the pop quizzes. The group project completely screwed me. The group project had no clear criteria and I got assigned the worst partners. Honestly take a different class for your gen ed.

Attendance is not required although there were a few pop quizzes. Homework was to read about a play a week and take a quiz online as well as to see three plays. Grades are from quizzes, a play review, midterm, group project, and final. Midterm and final were very very tough, lectures were not interesting but short. Ample extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Only homework was read the plays and take an easy 10 question quiz, usually once a week or so. One midterm and the final, which were multiple choice/true-false/matching. Basically show up and pass. Also have to attend 2 or 3 plays at Playmakers. We got out of class 15ish minutes early every day.

Not as easy as you'd think. Lecture is just her speeding through powerpoint she hasn't made, but she does post them after class. Random participation quizzes on the reading assigned. Her study guides do not help at all with the midterm and final. Take advantage of the extra credit she assigns, it's easy and you can do as much as you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The lectures are not relevant to the midterm or final exam at all. Snowden doesn't make the powerpoints herself and doesn't seem to know what she's lecturing. The exams were straight from quizlet but also random. The one project is assigned into random groups and you are graded as a group. No curves. Don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: For a drama teacher, her presentational skills are lacking. No stage presence, its almost as if shes acting like a teacher, and acting poorly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: In class Professor Snowden often seems unprepared (she doesn't create the PowerPoints she teaches from) and can be hard to work with. She based our 10% participation grade off of a few pop quizzes that most people did poorly on. Members for the group project are randomly assigned, so you there's a good chance you'll get stuck with a horrible group.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr Foster is great! Super funny and charismatic, makes lectures entertaining. Goes really fast and is sometimes hard to follow. The class content is difficult but Dr Foster does a great job of preparing you for exams. Homework was unreasonably hard and couldn't do any of it without outside help. Still a good experience and great professor.

I love this man. He explains concepts thoroughly and goes through several examples every class. Don't miss class, pay attention, and go to the review sessions! The EdFinity HW was much harder than the exams, so I usually ChatGPTed it. His practice midterms and final are more accurate to the difficulty of the exams.

Dr. Foster is the kindest teacher! He gives out candy at review sessions and helps students as much as he can. He gives very helpful study guides for everything. The tests are very difficult, but if you study with the study guides, you will be ok. The lectures are hard to keep up with, but he is very funny. If you take this class, take it with him!

To preface, I'm not the strongest math student and Prof. Foster's lectures were quite stale but you you tell he's an enthusiastic individual and passionate about math. He didn't use guided notes and would often introduce a new topic and then run through examples on the chalkboard until the end of class so don't make it a habit to miss class.
Genuinely my goat. He's so funny and I loved going to class. Hadn't taken a math class in over a year and I had a great time. Very fair exams and engaging lectures, normal amount of homework.

I LOVE ALEX FOSTER! He is such an amazing professor and all around guy. He teaches very well and while attendance isn't mandatory, you'll definitely miss a lot if you don't go. He's a fast talker and writer, but will slow down when asked. His midterms are very fair, but do get harder as the course goes on. He is very approachable and understanding.

Very understanding guy, though the class does get progressively more difficult. The Edfinity homework can be very difficult and gets annoying when it's due in the middle of breaks, but does help you grasp the content. Does every lecture on the chalkboards which makes it a lot easier to learn, though sometimes methods other than his are simpler.

Amazing professor. He is very enthusiastic and excited about math. Overall, his lectures are informative and engaging. Things do move a little fast so you need to study on your own a bit. Attendance is not required but highly recommended as you will miss a lot of material and class isn't recorded. You do need to attend recitations though.

One of the best professors I've ever had in terms of teaching the material. Provides definitions, gives quick and easy to understand conceptual background, works through an example, lets the class do an example, then goes over it. It's crazy how you don't often come across professors like him who actually understand how people are meant to learn.
His enthusiasm for math rubs off on you and makes it easy to learn! Classes move fast (as with all other 231 professors), so be ready to learn

Prof Foster is a hilarious guy. Clearly he had a passion for math, even though not many students in the classroom matched his energy. If you study enough and go to his study sessions you can get an A on the exams. He's sometimes underprepared though like not having the midterm the night before the exam.
Great fella

Really nice dude, and you can tell that he loves math. No recorded videos or slides so be ready to attend class and take notes. Lectures consist of brief introduction to new material, followed by lots of practice problems. Exams aren't bad as long as you pay attention in lectures and do the homework. He's a funny guy, which makes class enjoyable.

Professor Foster taught efficiently, preparing students for success on midterms and the final. His lectures were all on chalkboards, resulting in a perfect pace for taking notes. Instead of bogging the lectures down with proofs, he provides many examples. Students with an aptitude for math will easily succeed in this class.

Fun teacher and seems excited to teach which is refreshing. Very helpful during office hours. As someone else mentioned, he does not record lectures. My only complaint is that the most difficult material was crammed into the last couple weeks. Generally good and well organized instructor with reasonable midterms.

Alex was super engaging in lecture and helpful in office hours. I also thought the exams were very fair. My only complaints were that lectures were not recorded and he did not upload any sort of lecture notes to Canvas, so if you missed class you were out of luck. Homeworks were also pretty challenging, but super nice guy and so passionate!

Actually had him for 233, but it wasn't listed. His lectures were great! He was funny and engaging, and really good at explaining difficult concepts in an understandable way. The HWs were sometimes hard, but the midterms were very fair and based on the review materials. He even brought candy to the review sessions :)

233 not listed BUT anyway great teacher. Very passionate about the subject and is able to teach super complex topics very well, incredibly well-liked. Sometimes got a bit sidetracked but it was interesting. I had conflicts with all office hours, he was easy to communicate with and set up other times with so I could get my questions answered!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Calc 1 is tough, no matter how you slice it. Dr. Foster went the extra mile to help us succeed; he even made review papers for each exam. His lectures are humorous, with tangents that provide brain breaks necessary to digest everything. Midterms were fair, and homework was challenging but excellent study material. His class is study hard, play hard
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Alex! He made the material super easy to learn and in a quirky way. He was super sweet and held review sessions for all the midterms and final. The homework was time-consuming and extremely difficult buttttt the midterms and final were significantly easier. He also replaced our lowest midterm grade with our final if we did better!!

Alex made learning calc 1 a fun experience. He is silly and wants you to really understand the material. The homework is way harder than any exam or what we learn in class. The exams are really reasonable for what is taught and he replaces the lowest one with the final exam grade if you do better on the final.

Great professor!! Take him if you can! Funny, quirky, and does a good job at teaching the material. Homework is going to be a million times harder than the class/exams so don't let that scare you. Only thing I didn't like was that HW was due the next night (so fri night if you had class thurs). Alex was great though! Plus exams were very reasonable

Foster is good lecturer and I felt I really knew the content. HW is unnecessarily hard, but the final and midterms were super easy in comparison. He also drops a bunch of bad grades at the end of the semester, making it pretty easy to do good if you do well on tests. He says a lot of funny thing but I love it “math is not a spectator sport”

Oh my GOD I love this man. I would give my life for him. I took calc in HS but had to take it again. Alex teaches so simply and explains every step. Hilarious, motivating, the perfect amount of quirky, gives extra credit, homework is harder than exams, super accessible and helpful. I promise you if you take a class with him you will not regret it.

Pretty easy class but the homework assignments are time consuming and unnecessarily hard. The 2 midterms and final were significantly easier than the homework. Overall a good class and a chill professor.

His teaching style consists of briefly reviewing theorems and using examples. That style worked for me, but I knew people who said that made them more confused. His exams were hard, but he is pretty good about partial credit. The homework took forever and often did not help in terms of better understanding the concepts discussed in class.

Fantastic professor, Foster explains material that allows me to comprehend it even through I struggle with math. If you ask a question in class, he is quick to give a good explanation. He is also very accessible outside of class, and offers plenty of helpful material to study for the exams.

Alex is awesome and made taking Calc I honestly not so bad. You can tell her truly cares so much about his students (from bringing us candy at review sessions to cracking many jokes with us in class). Midterms/final were super fair and homework was tedious (but way harder than the exams). Would highly recommend - he is so kind!!!

Cuts off points for using short forms, his way or the highway- you won't be tested on your knowledge but to how much you do things the way he wants you to even if your style is correct- requires you to submit hw in person, teaching style is awful
