Work is fairly easy if you go to class and listen in class. All the answers for the assignments are mentioned in class and he has a tutorial video for each assignment. I got a B because I barely went to class and got average grades on the assignments.

Dr. Harrison is very caring and wants the best for you to succeed in his class. You need to pay for an website called packback for the class but the assignments on it are very easy and can be completed in 15 min or less. Dr. Harrison is very helpful and allowed me to gain partial credit when I missed an assignment.

This was my first class with Dr. Harrison (online Summer) and I will definitely be recommending him to others and taking his classes again! He wants his students to succeed, and is passionate about his work. He responds quickly to emails, and is always willing to answers questions. He is by far the best professor I have had at UNC thus far.

Dr. Harrison is the best professor I've ever had the pleasure of taking a class with. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and he gives great lectures. Everything was open note so if you take good notes in class, the tests are not too difficult. He always responds to emails, even at midnight.
Midterm and final were kind of hard. Try to get old midterms from a friend to practice. Otherwise, moderate work load. Not the easiest class by any means, but take Harrison. Good guy.
Patrick Harrison is the most caring, kind, and warmhearted professor I have had a chance to encounter at UNC.  He is also an amazing lecturer :)

Dr. Harrison is an amazing professor who made the course paper manageable! He actually cares about students' mental health and well-being. Plenty of extra credit opportunities were provided, and deadlines were extended for students to make his class more convenient. Lectures were funny and inspiring, which was needed for the late afternoon.

Dr. Harrison is the nicest and most caring professor I've ever met. He is accessible outside of class. The class is based on one research paper (~20-30pgs); The paper has separate deadlines throughout the year, so it's bearable. Come to class! Participation is the only factor that could've made my A- to an A. I had a B+, and he rounded me to an A-!
A very caring teacher than knowledges the stresses of college students so he is super considerate
Amazing professor and overall person! Super kind, funny, and passionate about what he teaches. We need more like him at UNC. Very responsive to emails and flexible.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Truly one of a kind. UNC has a gem by having him teach here. He is so caring and truly respects and worried about all his students. He is funny and understand that you are not only a student, but a person as well. 10/10 recommend! Favorite professor at UNC!

This is hands down the best professor at UNC. He truly cares about his students and allows flexibility with deadlines in an effort to allow his students to actually learn things. He will help you in any way he can! Take as many of his classes as you can.

Nicest professor I have ever seen. Tries to present statistics in a very digestible way. However, class can be extremely slow. Additionally concepts are presented in such a general way that it causes it to mush with all of the other concepts we learned previously. This leads to things being more confusing than it needs to be. But overall easy class

I could not recommend Dr. Harrison enough. If I could take any class with him again, I would 100% would. He is so kind and he really cares about his students and their well-being.  Dr. Harrison is genuinely such a caring person and he keeps lectures interesting.  You can make memes for extra credit in his class.  Take him if you can!!

Harrison is an awesome person, but I just want to warn that, at least in his Psych 210 class, you will succeed mostly if you are an auditory learner. Slides don't really contain any information that is helpful when it's exam time. He tries to assist outside of class, but if you can't process lots of information auditory, get ready for a battle.
one of the best professors at UNC! I had him for both psyc210 and psyc270 and still use what he taught me. I highly recommend a class with Patrick, it's an easy A as long as you participate

I took Harrison for PSYC210 last fall and my choice to take him again for PSYC270 this fall was one of the best choices I have made at UNC. Dr. Harrison is kind, caring, and one of the best professors I've ever had at UNC. The material in this class is difficult but with Dr. Harrison it's manageable

Professor Harrison is one of my favorites at UNC. He tries to make the class as easy to understand as possible. The assignments are relatively easy, but the midterm and final were challenging. He is super easy to work with and flexible with deadlines to meet student feedback.
Dr. Harrison is the best! I was lucky enough to have him for both 210 and 270 and he is amazing. Truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed both inside and outside the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: best professor I've had at UNC. genuinely cares about his students and their success.

Dr. Harrison is great, and any pre-health should take this class if they need statistics. He is caring and doesn't pull dumb stunts or make things too difficult. He is one of the few professors who cares for the mental well-being of his students. The main components of the course are assignments, quizzes, participation, and the midterm and final.

I took 210 and 270 with Dr. Harrison. He is the kindest professor I have ever had. The class itself is research-heavy. You will have to conduct and write a research paper (25-30 pages). But Dr. Harrison made it durable. He always writes kind words to us and tells us how much he appreciates our efforts and energy. Dr. Harrison is the best.

Having Dr. Harrison as a professor was a breath of fresh air. If you can take one of his classes as a UNC student, DO IT!!! I can't recommend him enough. He is accommodating, cares about the well-being of his students, and wants his students to succeed!!! The material is easily digestible when learning through him.

Dr. Harrison is indeed so very kind. I found the course design to be challenging - with it being so large and so writing-intensive, it was challenging to know what was going on. I'd suggest taking a smaller section if it is offered.
Dr. Harrison is the most caring professor I have ever had. I recommend taking him 1000000% Stats is not my favorite subject, but Dr. Harrison made it easy to understand.

THE BEST PROFESSOR AT UNC!! I love him to bits. If you have to take a stats class, take this one!! I had to take it for a pre-med requirement and I had taken AP Stats before and didn't love it, but I loved this class. He makes everything so easy to understand and he really wants everyone to succeed. TAKE ANY CLASS WITH HIM.

Patrick is potentially the nicest professor I have had here. I strongly recommend taking a class with him if at all possible. He really tried to make sure everyone gets an A and is incredibly kind to students. Every assignment has a 24 hour deadline buffer to help students.

Dr. Harrison is AMAZING!!! He is so caring and really empathizes with his students. Class is an easy A, so don't worry about it at all; you will have 1 big paper due at the end that you get to work on throughout the semester.

Amazing professor!!! Stats can be really intimidating but he made them very approachable. He is a great lecturer and a really caring professor. Even if u hate stats, this is one of the best classes Ive taken so id definitly recommend.

Dr. Harrison is one of the best professors I have had at UNC. He is so kind and understanding. He acknowledges that we are people with lives, not just students. Psych 210 with him was very doable, and he went very slowly. The final was tough but fair. He prepared us well with in-class reviews and many resources! Take any class with him!

Just amazing!! Dr. Harrison is one of my favorite professors I've ever had. He genuinely wants all of his students to succeed inside and outside of the classroom. Definitely recommend taking a class with him!
Literally the best and most sincere professor I've ever had at UNC. All Neuro majors should take research methods with him.

Dr. Harrison is AMAZING. I literally don't have enough room to describe it all. He livestreams class on Zoom, gives grace periods for assignments, quizzes and exams are open-note, there are extra credit opportunities, slides are posted online, etc. etc. etc. He is also SUCH a nice person and a hilarious lecturer. Easy A if you put in effort.
He is genuinely the sweetest person and this class was so a breeze to get through thanks to him and the great IA team.

Genuinely one of the best if not the best professor I have had in the psych dept. He is so caring for his students and he made a subject a definitely would've struggled with extremely easy. He is very flexible with deadlines if you need it, and is always willing to work with you. Make sure to take his class if you get the chance, he is amazing!

Wonderful man. I would go to his lectures and just online shop on my computer with my roommate. He is so funny and caring, he makes the weirdest jokes but he is adorable so it is fine. If you make memes about statistics, he gives you extra credit. Pretty easy class
I have had Prof Harrison for Psyc 210 and 270 and I highly recommend taking his classes! He is definitely one of the most caring and accommodating professors I have ever had!

Dr. Harrison is a great teacher, and he is skilled at making a seemingly difficult subject easily digestible for beginner level stats learners. Highly recommend this class and any class Dr. Harrison teaches!

Definitely take a class with Prof Harrison. Literally the most laid back professor ever. He cares about his students, but understands that everyone has other responsibilities as well. He tries to make his class as easy to take as possible. I've taken two classes with him already and they've both been great. Really cool guy

Dr. Harrison is the. best. He not only has a straight forward and cohesive teaching format, but he is timely on grading things and giving feedback. His assignments and quizzes are fair. If you go to class and take notes, you will do well! He takes into account student mental health and even acknowledges the inhumane usage of statistical tests.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take any class with him if you can! A great lecturer, makes an hour and 15 minute class go by fast. There are smaller assignments throughout the class but they're generally open note, so just take some decent notes and ask questions when needed and you'll be fine. Harrison makes statistics fun and engaging!

This man is an absolute gem! If you ever need to take an upper-level Psyc Maymester (which sounds pretty horrible), this is the class to take. The topic was interesting, but the professor is really what makes the class. He does everything in his power to make a 2.5-week semester as painless as possible, while still effectively teaching. Amazing!!

Very easy class, and you get the grade you want. It is very easy to get at least 90-95% on the assignments, participation, and quizzes. The final was a little harder than the midterm, but very doable. Harrison's explanations are wonderful, and you should try to pick him if you can. It's a very easy A if you go to class and do the work on time

Dr. Harrison is one of my favorite professors I have had at UNC. He is extremely caring and passionate about statistics. I will def be taking 270 with him. The only thing that got me was the weekly assignments because the IAs were a little strict with grading but a lot of feedback was provided. It is hard not to get an A in this class.

Dr. Harrison was an amazing professor -- I cannot recommend him enough. As a non STEM major, I was a little nervous about taking a stats class, but he made the content very easy to understand. He's a professor that really cares about the people who take his class as people, not just as students.

Professor Harrison is nice and caring about students. His class is enjoyable and tests are not really hard to finish. I missed a quiz so I only got partial credits on it so that's why I got a A-. But overall he is a nice person and is easily accessible outside classes. He also offer many extra credits so it's not hard to get an A.

AMAZING PROF. Its very obvious that he genuinely cares for his students and he will repeatedly remind you of this. He's also good about giving extensions and extra credit. I was dreading this class, but he made it fun and engaging. The content isn't too difficult, either. Strongly recommend Dr. Harrison and I look forward to future classes with him

Best prof I have had at UNC. He is so caring and really wants his students to learn! Assignments are very fair and if you need help he is super accessible outside of class. I mean he lets you make memes for extra credit. 10/10

Super sweet. Sometimes gave ambiguous answers to questions which made a few MC questions difficult. It was easy to access him outside of class and he was generally not a harsh grader. Homework assignments were usually easy. ULAs were super helpful. Tendency to ramble at the beginning of class. All graded assignments open internet and open note.

Best professor I've had at UNC. For a class with some complicated topics, he makes the content digestible and is super patient. His ULA/educational team is also great and, collectively, they really care about your well-being. Attend class, watch tutorial vids for assignments, do the lesson polls, ask questions, and you'll be fine.

The best professor I have ever had. Dr. Harrison is really nice and kind. He is very understanding and put students' well-being before anything else. He is a great lecturer and very patient. Super accessible. If every professor at UNC are like him, UNC would be a much better place academically and mentally.

Great guy. This is the second class I've taken with him and he has yet to disappoint. Super considerate of student's needs and wellbeing. I've never met a person that loves psyc/stats more than him. He's very passionate and wants you to succeed. Don't be thrown by the 25 page paper. You work on it throughout the semester...over before you know it.

Dr. Harrison is the most caring professor I've ever had. He takes in consideration of our feelings as students and understands what we go through. This class is very straightforward and thorough which is awesome to have a class that is very laid back. Honestly, I would recommend Dr. Harrison to anyone who needs to take psych classes.

There is a reason Dr. Harrison is so widely loved and respected in the psyc department. I took 270 as an online class without taking 260 first and still did very well in his class. He does a great job at explaining the material and making his lectures engaging. He is very accommodating and works hard to ensure his students are doing ok.

Dr. Harrison is so nice! There are weekly assignments, a few quizzes, and two tests. All of the tests and quizzes are open notes. He makes learning statistics as simple as possible. There isn't much math involved in this course, it's mainly conceptual. You can make memes for extra credit. Packback is frustrating, though.
Honestly, Prof H is basically everyone's dad and everyone loves him. Absolutely take his class, it will be the best decision you ever make.

Professor Harrison is an amazing professor that truly cares about his students' wellbeing. He goes above and beyond to ensure all students are understanding the course material and are comfortable in his class. He is so compassionate and the work load is quite light. I would definitely recommend!

Dr. Harrison is awesome! No other way to put it. He is incredibly caring and understanding. This class seems overwhelming but he really broke it down for students and in the end, you could tell he wanted all of us to get A's. There will be hard times in this class, but it is final heavy and you will likely do well on the final.

Everybody loves Dr. Harrison. He is the most respectful and caring professor I've had, and he will do everything in his power to make sure you do well in the course. Definitely go to office hours if you have any difficulty with the material. About half of your grade is based on one paper (16.67% on drafts of the paper, 33% on the Final Paper).

Prof Harrison is one of the kindest and most caring professors I have ever had. The class was very straightforward with an assignment every week and a few quizzes. He is a fantastic teacher and makes a large lecture feel very personal which is uncommon. Definitely recommend him for any PSYC classes!

cant say enough good things about him. so accommodating and actually cares about our mental health. not hard to make an A if you put in enough work. weekly homework, 4 or 5 quizzes, a midterm, a final, and participation. stats isnt super interesting but i wouldnt take it with anyone else 3

P. Harrison is by far the best professor I have ever had ( I am a junior). Most professors do not care about you even if they say you do but prof Harrison actually does and it is blatantly obvious. I am so glad I got to take this class with him. He has a weekly assignment (does not take long), 1 quiz every 2 weeks, 3 exams. You can def do it.

Dr. Harrison was very nice. I REALLY did not want to take this class and was a little afraid to, but he assuaged those fears right out of the gate. The class teaches about statistics (relevant to psychology) in a conceptual way, not a hands-on way. Don't worry about having to get your calculator out. 19/10.

He is very clear and accessible. Class was very straightforward, and had a lot of group work. There was a lot of time to do work during class, ask questions and review what to do for the final project paper. Great class with a great professor and would totally recommend.

Dr. Harrison is one of the nicest and most accommodating professors I have ever had. He is very clear on the criteria for the semester-long paper and helps in any way he can. There are 2 learning checks and a final, but he gives you everything you need to know to do well. You can tell his goals are just helping us learn. Absolutely amazing, 1000/10

Dr. Harrison is an absolute king. He genuinely cares about students and wants them to succeed as much as possible. He is always willing to lend a helping hand and makes his expectations clear and concise. Love this guy and highly recommend his classes.

I love Dr. P. This class was veryyyy easy, the only effort that goes into it is the semester long paper ( 20 pages) due at the end. It was a nice breather between my other classes and he is super nice and caring, as are the TA's!

Dr. Harrison is quite literally an ANGEL. Stats-based class scared me but assignments/content are so clear it's hard to not do well. He genuinely cares about his students and makes sure you are personally doing well outside of course content! He offers plenty of extra credit and is super flexible. Seriously, take any and all classes with him!

Easily one of the best professors I have taken since being here. He is compassionate and amazing at making difficult topics easy to understand. Lectures can be a little long and wordy, but attendance is not required so it's no big deal.

Dr. Harrison is the best professor I've ever had at UNC, and definitely the best professor you'll ever have if you take him. He is leagues above; incredibly caring and understanding, he puts in 100% effort to make the class easy and fun, and grading criteria is always clear (and if it isn't or there's an issue, he is consistently accessible).

Dr. Harrison is the best!!!! He is so kind snd understanding about your needs as a human and his lectures are amazing. He gives extra credit for making memes related to class content and posts them on the board at the beginning of class for us to see. He makes a rather boring subject quite fun and does whatever he can to make sure we understand it.

Such a good guy, and you can tell he really cares about the well being of his students. Doesnt take too much work per week- just watch lectures and spend an hour completing weekly assignment. Short quizzes every other week and one midterm and one exam. Content is spread out nicely, not too overwhelming. Loved this class.

prof H is one of the most caring, personable people I have ever known. he truly does care for his students and does everything he can to make sure we're doing okay. lots of leeway and understanding on assignment submission. if you're honest with him you're probably good to go. best prof I have had at UNC so far. easy pass class.

I am so bad at math and was really stressed about taking this stats class (required for the psych major) but Prof Harrison was AMAZING! He's so funny and genuinely cares about his students. He gives great examples and doesn't go super fast and leave you confused like some profs. Now I'm taking 270 with him! I wish we were besties tbh def take him!!

Professor Harrison is great. Super understanding and wants you to do well. Offers extra credit and lots of study resources. Hardest part was the weekly SPSS assignments because my TA was a tough grader, but I still did well in the class. I Highly recommend Professor harrison!

Dr. Harrison was amazing. He just wants us to learn the material in the easiest way possible and makes sure to answer every question thats asked. I would definitely take a class with him if I were you!

Dr. Harrison is one of the most caring professors I have had at UNC. He is very knowledgable and more than willing to talk to students about their interests and support them beyond his class. I learned so much from him in both PSYC 210 and PSYC 501.

Literally the nicest guy ever. I ended up having difficulties due to personal stuff, but he tried really hard to help and was so forgiving. He's so helpful and cares so much about what he's teaching, and I hate stats, but he managed to make it enjoyable. Genuinely the best professor I've ever had.

This was a great course! It was online when I took it, but essentially the whole class wrote one paper together either about COVID or Fake News. It was hard work, but the way Dr. Harrison splits the work up over the semester by the end you feel like it wasn't too bad and evenly spaced. Great professor- really cares for students and great explainer.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class was very easy, and I was able to keep up very easily. Dr. Harrison makes the content super accessible, and also really cares about his students. Definitely take with him if you can!

Dr. Harrison is the kindest professor I've ever had. He made sure that we learned but not to the point where our mental health was at risk. One assignment per week in recitation, and a few multiple choice quizzes and exams that were open notes. Engaging lectures, he is always very enthusiastic and truly cares about what he teaches!

Amazing class! Dr. Harrison turned a boring topic into something fun. Lectures are engaging and he really cares about the health and well-being of his students. Breaks down the class into manageable components and has incredibly clear grading criteria for everything. Although it may seem like a lot at first, Dr. Harrison makes it easy to succeed!
The GOAT. Took professor Harrison for 210 and 270. You really can not find a better professor.

Professor Harrison did not make any lectures or recitations mandatory to help with the pressure of covid, and all deadlines on assignments were extended until the end of the semester, so nothing was given a late grade. He also gave a lot of extra credit! Best Psychology professor.

Dr. Harrison is an awesome professor! You would not regret taking his class because Dr. Harrison makes sure his students understands the concept and do good in his class. He also gives a lot of examples for students to use! I would take his class again if I could. The class material is easy and the exams are very easy. Excellent professor! :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Harrison was one of the most caring and helpful professors I've had. He really made sure to be flexible with students and tried really hard to set everyone up for success in his class. He also provides loads of examples and explains complex topics in multiple ways so that everyone can understand.

This class was so much fun and quite easy. All you need for the assignments is to attend recitation, and to pass the quizzes just take basic notes. The final exam was definitely the most tricky and bought everyones grade down. Harrison was super nice and easy going and extended deadlines whenever needed, Very understanding as well as the ta's!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Harrison is AMAZING! He really cares for his students and wants us all to succeed! There are 10 homework assignments (about 1 per week) that are easy and straightforward. The midterm was super easy in my opinion but the final was slightly harder because it was more application-based. Statistics is a difficult topic but he taught it very well!

Dr. Harrison is an AMAZING professor! He was super lenient during the pandemic. You can tell he genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Lectures can get boring at times, but the material isn't too hard to grasp. There is recitation and weekly assignments, but not too time consuming. Just study for the tests and you'll do well.

So I took his class during the totally remote fall semester and was relieved when I found out it was async - but then we had to do a whole bunch of group work for this paper, which was unfortunate because I hadn't blocked those hours off of work. Patrick is very nice and kind but his grading criteria made easy things difficult to parse through.

Dr. Harrison is a great prof, especially during these times. There is a huge paper that is worth a chunk of the grade and most of your grade is broken down by intro, methods, and discussion and then the final paper. It is pretty tedious but he takes the time to construct the whole thing together. Help is provided. Very fair and accommodating.

Harrison did amazing adjusting to covid. He made half of the assignments due at the midterm and half due for LDOC so you had to keep up in some form but not every week. He explains everything clearly and thoroughly using examples. You could attend synchronously/asynchronously. He does not drop any low grades so beware of due dates and quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's so nice that I feel regretful to take his course during this unusual time - I believe I would learn much more if we had face-to-face classes. PSYC 270 has a group research project with a report paper. It is more difficult than I've expected but luckily he breaks them into steps and it really helps! TAKE HIS CLASS. He won't let you down.

Professor Harrison is the best professor I have ever had. Makes stats extremely easy to understand and I don't think I have ever had a more caring educator in my entire life. If you have the chance to take ANY class with him, I would HIGHLY recommend it.

Dr. Harrison is the best professor I've ever had. I had never taken a stats class before, but I went through the semester thinking it was so easy because he did a great job explaining things! He cares SO much about his students. During COVID he was very understanding and cared for us. The recitation is super boring though. Easy to get a good grade.

Pat Harrison is hands down one of the most caring and amazing professors I have had at my time at UNC. Psych 210 with him was easy because he is so good at explaining, and the assignments that he gives us are so helpful in ensuring you learn the material. Such a great professor, highly recommend. Seriously, any class you can take w him- DO IT!

Dr. Harrison is a TRUE GEM!! Hands down one of the best professors I have had at UNC. He cares so much about his students and is just a great guy. Tries to keep things lighthearted and fun when possible. He is so knowledgeable about what he's teaching too!

TAKE A CLASS WITH DR HARRISON!!!!! I love him and couldn't recommend him enough! He is really caring and makes a topic like statistics 1000x more bearable than I thought it would be. The work he gives is fair and really helped me to understand the subject matter. 10/10 he is amazing.
One of my favorite professors at UNC. So caring and such a good professor as well. I learned so much and had a great time in class. Very accommodating when we switched to online learning. 1000/10.
One of the best professor I had in UNC. He really cares about his students. Quizzes is harder than the exam but as long as you come to class, it should be an easy A.

Dr. Harrison is such a great person and professor! Research methods is a dry class, but Dr. Harrison does a great job at making it engaging and interesting. The class is not test driven, it's more about the final paper/ research project, but he guides you through the whole thing.

Dr. Harrison is AMAZING. I've never rated a professor before, but he deserves it. The class was awesome before and during quarantine. He is extremely accessible and so kind. All he wants is for his students to do well. As long as you study some, pay attention in class, participate, and put forth good effort on the homework, you will be just fine!!!
Dr. Harrison is very friendly, very resourceful, and cares a lot about his students! He's shared cute pet photos with us before exams to put us in good spirits.

Professor Harrison is awesome. Such a cool guy who really cares about his students. He makes a material as dry as stats pretty comprehensible and the lectures are quite entertaining. Wants everyone to do well. He never tries to trick you and is always encouraging us in our efforts to make sense of the material. Can't say enough about this man!
Really cool dude!

Dr. Harrison is awesome!! Super approachable and understanding. Basically a semester long paper written with your recitation section. Grading is very subjective by the TA's but if you disagree with your grade take it to Dr. Harrison and he will help you understand why you got this grade/if it should be changed. He made the class fun with stories!

A true Carolina gem. Dr. Harrison is the BEST professor in the Psychology department. Class is very fair and is obviously very organized by Dr. Harrison beforehand. He is more than accessible outside of class and really helped me when some non-academic things came up in life. Take any of his classes, they are all fantastic!

I LOVED Dr. Harrison! He was really chill and was always eager to help. He was constantly looking for feedback from students so that he could adjust if needed. PSYC 210 was pretty easy, 10 rec. assignments, 5 in-class quizzes, and 2 exams!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Harrison is a great professor, and a truly kind, caring, and genuine person. He really cares about his students. PSYC270 is not difficult, but difficulty depends on what TA you have, since they grade all of your papers (which makes up most of your grade). But there is clear grading criteria and sample papers you can use to get that A!

Professor Harrison genuinely wants every one of his students to succeed. Hes the type of person who was born to be a professor. The combination of his lectures and your recitation gives you plenty of chances to learn the material in different ways and ask as many questions as you want. If you put in a couple hours a week, an A is easily attainable.

This was a pretty easy class, most of it was writing a semester long research paper with your recitation group. All paper guidelines were really clear and if you go through the lecture slides before quizzes, you should do pretty well. Dr. Harrison is super nice and personable too, I'd definitely take him!

Dr. Harrison is seriously the best prof I've had at UNC. He's super accessible and willing to help his students. He's very knowledgeable about the material. If something didn't seem fair- he's very willing to adjust to help everyone. I had him both for 210 and 270. Seriously, take a class with him- you won't regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Harrison is a great teacher and person. He truly cares about students and wants them to succeed. He makes concepts easy to understand and without using math. I've never taken a stats course so I was worried, but I am doing just fine. I don't particularly find recitation useful though. He also uses poll everywhere for participation every day.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I was worried for this class because I'm not really a math person, but Dr. Harrison is the bomb. He's funny and is good at relating the concepts we learn in class to the greater aspects of the psych field. Look over the quizzes before the exams, that will help a lot!

Had him for 210 and 270. Unpopular opinion maybe: I didn't think his lectures were super organized. When studying I found that lecture didn't prepare me super well for tests. His powerpoints had a lot of funny pictures but not a lot of helpful material which I would have wanted given there is no textbook. He's very nice, go to his office hours.

Dr. Harrison is great. He teaches you what you need to know and makes it relevant to the outside world, so it is understandable. He is always helpful and willing to answer questions. He is also pretty funny during lecture and clearly wants to make sure every student has the chance to succeed.

I thought this class was hard, but that's because I'm a math person. Patrick dumbed everything down, which is good for some, but not for others. I had to teach myself a lot, especially bc I had the worst TA. I was disappointed with the quizzes in this class as we had barely touched upon the material before. However, Patrick is sweet & passionate.

Professor Harrison's class is not that easy if you are not a math person. I had to teach myself a lot of the material because he made it more confusing by oversimplifying it. The redeeming part of this class is that he's a super nice guy and he's willing to answer your questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I love this man!! While my TA was a particularly harsh grader, I absolutely loved Patrick. I visited him in office hours several times, he went over my quizzes and exams with me, and we talked about my plans for research and grad school. Honestly, he is my favorite professor in the psych department, and there's a lot of good ones. Take him!!

Prof. Harrison is incredibly nice and is by far one of the easiest classes I have taken at UNC. It was WELL worth my time. I didn't find the material particularly interesting, but his up-beat mood definitely made it better. I shot myself in the foot by not taking the midterm seriously but a little studying goes a long way. Easy A if you try.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Patrick is awesome! Take him for 210 and 270 if you can! He makes difficult concepts so much easier to understand and he is an awesome lecturer! He is also a very nice and charismatic guy. One of my favorite professors at UNC.

Patrick is amazing. I've had both PSYC 210 and 270 with him and he knows me by face/name. He is funny, caring, and super helpful when you want feedback or clarification. He makes learning somewhat dull topics fun and interesting.

One of the BEST professor I got in UNC. He is so nice and he always explains concepts very clearly. Also, he is always there to help and he can even help with your problems applying for an internship!

Professor Harrison is one of the most considerate professors I have ever had! He truly cares about his students and values our feedback. The TA's usually grade tougher than he does. There was only one midterm but it was pretty easy. Definitely a doable A if you study.

Dr. Harrison is the man. Hes funny, down to earth, and very smart. He presents the material in a way thats easy to understand and wont move on until his students get it. He stays after every class to answer questions and is always nice. The TAs help a lot too and recitation is good for understanding the materials. Its a cool class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: PATRICK IS AMAZING! He is straightforward and an excellent teacher. He cares so much about his students and wants them to achieve! He is knowledgable and wants to share his love for psychology. I've taken psyc 210 and 270 with him and loved both classes. The group "paper" in 270 is not complicated and completed (mostly) in recitation.

Favorite professor ever! He's hilarious and he makes the subject material interesting. There are 3 exams and 10 recitation HWs. The exams are not hard, but definitely require a solid understanding of the material. He tries to make the exams as easy as possible; none of the exams are cumulative. Participation counts and he gives extra credit.

He tries to explain the material in an understandable way, but he just doesn't. Bc he tries to make concepts conceptual & not math related, he ends up making them more complicated & difficult to understand by substituting concrete terms/ideas w/ words like "thing" or "stuff". I can see how some people'll'd understand his teaching style, but I don't

psyc210 overall isnt math heavy, it's just conceptual. you use a program to do the math for you, but you learn what the program is doing to get the output and what the output means. patrick is so cheesy, it's wonderful. tests aren't too bad, he tries to make them clear and not too tricky. weekly recitation assignments are easy.

Dr. Harrison is a wonderful professor. He is funny and interesting, and lectures are rarely boring. However, he does have a very meditative voice that makes it hard to focus sometimes if you are tired. If you study hard, tests aren't bad. He is helpful with papers outside of class.
You can tell that Dr. Harrison really cares about how his students do. If you put in the effort, this class isn't too bad. It's also really interesting.

Patrick is my favorite prof. at UNC. I took PSYC210 with him last semester, and sprinted to take one of his classes again. It's always clear that he's on the same team as his students, and he keeps class interesting; I have margins on my notes filled with his hilarious quotes. He also genuinely cares about his students too and is fair/reasonable.

This is my second class with Dr. Harrison, and he's brilliant professor. While I liked him in the first class I took, it was clear to me that he took feedback seriously, and he adjusted elements of his teaching accordingly. He is very easy to reach out to outside of class, and makes material engaging and easy to understand.

Chill and laid-back professor! Lectures are relaxed, somewhat boring. Recitation assignments, exams, and Poll Everywhere make up the bulk of grades. The oversimplification of lecture materials is a bit misleading when it comes to exams. No math involved at all. Simply knowing the basic information is not enough; make sure you REALLY understand!

Dr. Harrison is easily one of the best professors UNC has to offer. He makes a terrifying subject (Stats) approachable and easy. He knows nobody enjoys stats and tries to make it as easy and understandable as possible. His tests had 3-5 questions that were oddly worded and tricked us, but he asked the class for feedback b/c he cares. Take his class

Love love love Dr. Harrison! He's friendly, approachable, and tries to make lecture as fun as possible - even though the subject might be terribly boring. Participation is 20% of your grade and matters a LOT, so do show up to class - even if you don't want to. Recitation assignments are super easy, and tests are fine as long as you study.

Dr. Harrison is my favorite professor at UNC. He's so caring and engaging, he even made stats fun for me. He genuinely cares about each student doing well and making the material understandable. Participation is a huge part of the grade and the TAs help a lot with the assignments. I strongly recommend him and plan on taking more classes with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Harrison is my favorite professor at UNC.  He's easy to reach, super cool, and makes stats funny and engaging.  He also makes himself available for things besides class (asking about different areas of psychology, offering to write recommendations once he knows you better, etc). Makes an effort to know his students.  11/10!

The best professor that I've ever had at UNC. There's absolutely no math involved and if you study for twenty minutes before the test, you're guaranteed an A. Attendance is taken by polleverwhere, so I usually show up for the first five minutes of class and then leave. Definitely would take again!

LOVE HARRISON. He is one of my favorite professors at UNC. He expects you to attend class and participate, but if you need to miss he is super understanding. His tests are straightforward. He's a pretty young guy so he's really relatable. I took stats with him and I'm in PSYC 501 with him now and taking 270 in the fall. RECOMMEND!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The class material and lectures were easy to understand. He explains stuff well and leaves plenty of time to review for exams. Textbook is required but you won't need it. Basically everything you need to know will be in the slides. Do participate in class though, I never missed a class but got a 70 for my participation grade.

Patrick is awesome! Makes lecture interesting, easy class, very fair and willing to take input about what the class wants. Young and understands what it is like to be a student. He does grade participation very harshly so make sure you speak in class and see him in office hours at least once.

You live by the test, you die by the test. I wish this class had more opportunities for students to demonstrate their knowledge on the law and court precedent. Instead 70% of the grade goes to two online tests with large multiple-choice sections. Unah is a very nice guy, but the laxity was too much. Class would begin far-later than scheduled.

I would recommend taking this class if you're pre-law. It's a great class and the assigned readings were actually interesting and not dense. Dr. Unah is a great professor and is an easy grader. The midterm and final exams are online.

I found the disorganization infuriating and he wasn't super accessible over email either. He is a very nice man but ultimately I did not like the class and even though I did all the work and read every textbook, still ended up with an unideal grade because of one assignment.

Dr. Unah is very knowledgeable and funny, despite his disorganization. You have to buy a lot of books and make sure you do the reading because all of his quizzes are based on the readings. Overall, not too difficult of a class but I learned a lot and would recommend it. The worst part is the paper, but you get a partner.

Dr Unah is a great professor. I think people need to give professors some grace. Unah is funny and caring. Definitely go to office hours and get to know him. He also has a lot of connections. If you're interested in law, take this. Easy A class - one midterm, 6 quizzes (drops lowest 2), a partner paper, and final. Exams are online which is nice

I love Dr. Unah! His style is not going to be for everyone, as you can tell from other reviews. However, if you can get past his high level of disorganization, his classes are really enjoyable. He has so much passion for his discipline, loves talking to students who are interested in law school, and is just a great guy overall. Would recommend!

Dr. Unah is a great professor. His lectures were engaging and he is funny. The class is fairly easy, and I would recommend to those needing a 400 level course. Class consist of online midterm, 6 easy quizzes, one 15-ish partner paper, and online final exam.  Readings were easy and not dense.  Would recommend this class for easy A / A- .

Great professor, is engaging, and passionate about what he teaches.  He is a lenient grader, lets you know what is going to be on the quizzes, and he pushed the midterm back 3 times because the class begged him to.  He is a bit disorganized which makes it hard to prepare before the class. He did show up to the final late because of Canvas issues.

Isaac Unah is the most disorganized professor that I have ever had, whether at a community college or at UNC. He shows up 7 to 10 minutes late to every class, and even showed up 20 minutes late on the Final test. At one point in the class, we were 5 to 6 weeks behind the syllabus, and he pushed the midterms back three times.  
Do not take
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Unah is a man who clearly cares about the material that he teaches, and he is very knowledgeable. He is also the most disorganized professor I've ever had. He has delayed midterms and quizzes simply because he forgot they were happening. Material on quizzes and exams are barely covered in class. He is late to class every day. Beware taking him.

Unah is very engaging and makes the lectures interesting by adding in things that are happening in our world today. He really wants you to succeed and his grading is pretty lenient. The only thing I would say is that he is very disorganized and that can sometimes make the class more difficult than it needs to be.

Professor Unah was genuinely one of the best professors i've had at UNC. I had seen his reviews beforehand but was pleased to find he was nothing like what his rating on here would make him out to be. He cares so much for all his students and places a heavy emphasis on ensuring that his students come out of the class prepared for their future.

Dr. Unah is incredibly disorganized.  There are around six required textbooks needed for class, and the syllabus was unreliable to a crazy degree. The final paper for this class had unclear instructions that were contradicted by both the syllabus and in class lectures. Grade is based on three exams, a paper, and random quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Unah is a little all over the place. If you go to class and actually pay attention, you can easily get a good grade. There are a ton of readings but the most important one is his own book. That one you definitely need to buy and read if you want to get good grades on the exam. Also you have to do data analysis so learn that.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Incredibly disorganized. No structure, long drone-y lectures. Quizzes in class, but would change quiz dates w/o updated the syllabus. Group project at the end w/ no clear instructions & confusing standards; he took points off for not finding evidence that wasn't there. He makes you buy 7 textbooks that you could get an A in the class w/o reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unah is very caring, but his disorganization is insane- and made learning very difficult in his class. Additionally, the final project was a group project with incredibly unclear instructions on an extremely niche topic that didn't contribute to our learning about the U.S. Supreme Court at all- some groups also had a much harder topic than others
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is extremely passionate about the Supreme Court and Constitutions. Lectures are so intriguing! He gave us feedback on the homework to make sure we really understand important concepts.
Super nice and knowledgeable professor! Very interesting lectures and the project was fun!

Great Professor and overall human being. We had 6 quizzes but he told us when we would have them ahead of time. Lectures were detailed from the reading. Take notes of what he says in class and what is on the power points as this would be the info on the quizzes. Final and midterm were information from the quizzes. Term paper was with a partner.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is a good professor who is very interested in the topics he teaches. However, he is very unorganized and his class lacks structure. His exams usually had random questions that were sometimes unrelated to what we were learning. The class was not super hard, but the way he taught the class was not the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Unah is a great professor who I believe genuinely cares about the success of his students. The only thing that I believe hampered Professor Unah is that during his lectures he would sometimes get on a tangent about certain topics that didn't add to the lecture. Other than that he was a great professor who knew a lot about the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Unah was extremely disorganized and always late. All of the tests had something wrong with them so our grades were not accurate. He assigns horrible projects that make no sense and have little information on them. He also required us to buy a lot of books including his own which was v expensive. He is a horrible professor, save yourself

Unah is a genuinely kind person and has a clear passion for judicial politics. However, this class was incredibly frustrating. I read these reviews before enrolling and misunderstood the degree of disorganization. We often had to correct him on his own tests and his chaos nearly ruined the class. So much potential but ultimately I would avoid.

TAKE IT!! Prof. Unah is super caring and humorous. His lectures are captivating and thought-provoking. We also learned some basic data analysis, which was great for conducting research and preparing for law school. Be aware of pop quizzes but it's hilarious that he listed some of their dates in the syllabus.

It is easy to see that Professor Unah cares deeply about his classes and the topic. However, he was so disorganized it made the class suffer. He required us to buy 6 textbooks, the most expensive of which was his book. The class consisted of random lectures and a final project, and there were problems with EVERY exam grading was ALWAYS a mess.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: PLEASE do NOT take his class. Unah is the most disorganized professor I have ever had. Worst class I have taken. Barely learned anything at all. Late to the first day of class by 10 minutes if that says literally anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Unah is very passionate about constitutional law and the Supreme Court. He is an amazing professor, and all of the readings are case studies. I highly recommend taking this class if you're passionate about the supreme court or case precedent. Many of the people who expressed dislike for the class were people simply taking it for a credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love this man. While he is pretty disorganized, his tests are fair and he is very passionate about the subject matter. I am a super type A person and still felt that I learned a lot even with the disorganization. He is so funny and really cares about his students.

While the material was interesting, Professor Unah was not a great instructor. He was late, disorganized, and unclear. Lectures consisted of unrelated tangents and opportunities to flex his ego. At times it seemed like he was more interested in trying to prove how cool he was instead of properly preparing us for exams/assignments. I would avoid.

Professor Unah as a person is fantastic, but as an educator he is not great. He's clearly smart and empathetic, but his disorganization, fixation on certain topics, and tendency to ramble meant some classes covered absolutely nothing of substance. The tests and papers are also surprisingly difficult. Nice man, but I'd find someone else if you can.

Don't want to disrespect the professor but can't advise anyone to take this class Professor was often late to class, weeks behind the syllabus, never replied to emails, after the final a paper from October has not been graded now December no idea what grade I will get. Quizzes in class random, numerous spelling mistakes in the final. etc etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't know why all of the reviews for Dr. Unah are so bad, I think he's funny. I took POLI 416 with him during the Fall semester of 2022 and I loved him and this class. If you do the readings and take notes on the textbooks, you can easily get A's on quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unah is a very kind person and the content he taught was fascinating. It was difficult to be in this class because of his lack of structure in class meetings. Many class periods went wasted discussing meaningless things which led us to be very behind on the syllabus. Tests are weighed VERY heavily with the final being almost half the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: An absolute clown of a professor. Completely disorganized and the students suffer from his lack of professionalism. Gives a quiz 5 minutes before the final exam because he forgot to give it to us when we had an appropriate amount of time for it. Doesnt respond to students comments or concerns, shows up late, rambles, terrible content. horrendous.

The most unorganized class I have taken. The class was consistently confused and was given little to no guidelines on how to prepare for anything. The tests were often filled with random trivia and the schedule set in the syllabus was completely inconsistent with what occurred. Overall I am let down because the content of the class is interesting.
He gave a quiz 5 minutes before the final exam. That's all.

Professor Unah is really nice but horribly disorganized. We were consistently over a month behind. His tests are hard and he often will put random questions on there that he never spoke about and expects us to know the answers. He also doesn't really budge on any of his test questions even when they're obviously unclear and not written well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Unah is nice and cares about his students, the material was interesting, and exams were straightforward. Not sure if it was the online format, but I never knew where we were on the syllabus or what we were supposed to have read for that day. We also barely received guidance for our term papers. Maybe this class would have been better in person.

Disorganized to the point that its inconsiderate of your time as a student. Almost two weeks have passed since the final and a grade has yet to be submitted, which could affect my GPA if it is not changed soon. Unreachable by email, unclear instruction during class time. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Unah was probably the most disorganized professor I've had at UNC. We were given few guidelines about our final papers, and we ended the semester really far behind the syllabus because he got distracted a lot and spent 4 classes on statistical analysis. he also never responded to emails, including to confirm the date of our final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not sure if it's the online format or what, but quite honestly, Dr. Unah is not great. I have never met anyone in my adult life that wears their responsibilities on their sleeve like Unah. He's always late, never prepared, cold calls during class, doesn't offer helpful feedback, and gives pop quizzes worth a good portion of your grade.

Professor Unah, Im sure, is a wonderful person. However, he is the most unorganized, uninspiring lecturers Ive ever had. The textbooks are mandatory but dont bother reading because hes just going to copy word for word haphazardly slapped on a PowerPoint for our viewing pleasure. Would not recommend.

Unah is an amazing professor-caring, knowledgeable, smart. His only flaw is organization; he tends to get excited and spends too much time on certain topics and neglects others. However, he does account for this in exams and quizzes. Do the readings, come to class, you'll be fine. A pretty lenient grader too!

The only reason I don't rate Unah a "5" is because of his organization and timeliness. He is a gem of a guy, but sometimes is unprepared and neglects to provide timely feedback for your grades. I didn't really know where I stood in the class until final grades came out. All said, Unah is still a good prof. Very knowledgable. Very enthusiastic.

Professor Unah is the most caring professor I've had at Carolina. He genuinely cares about his students and the material he teaches. However, he is incredibly unorganized. He often came to class not knowing what the topic on the syllabus was. I wouldn't recommend this for a freshman, but definitely take one of his classes at some point!

Unah's super kind and a whiz on the material. But we got off topic all the time. We weren't tested on stuff we didn't cover tho. Getting good test grades is key to your grade here (midterm 33%, final 37%). Multiple choice is hard to study for, often trivia stuff. Need to ace the short answers. Take good notes and stay ready for occasional quizzes!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Unah is very knowledgeable and passionate about the Constitution and Supreme Court, however is not the most organized. We did not get through many of the cases on the syllabus. There are short answer pop quizzes that count for 20% of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The material is super interesting and not hard. However, Dr. Unah tests you on bizarre random things that are impossible to prepare for. He is a wonderful man and will write you a letter of recommendation, just be aware that he is disorganized and parts of the tests are not representative of what he teaches in class. 40%  final; 30%midterm

Dr. Unah is a wonderful person, a great lecturer, and a very funny man. His Achilles heel is organization. In the class I took with him on Supreme Court cases, we ended up skipping about 15 cases in the syllabus because we spent too much time on other cases. Would still recommend, but be aware that's what you're getting into.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Even though Professor Unah was constantly late and disorganized, he really did have amazing lectures and cared about his students. If you can get past his tardiness and disorganization, you will love any class he teaches!

Yes, Unah does give pop quizzes (around 4 or 5 in semester) but he drops the lowest and they are NOT difficult. He is engaging & the material isn't very difficult. Just know your notes and you're good. Definitely recommend.

Unah's a researcher, not a teacher. Late to every class, very unorganized, & falls way behind on schedule. He had an obsession with teaching us regression analysis (not in class description). The little amount he did teach, he was repetitive & didn't prepare us for the research paper or exam. We didn't learn for a month once. Wouldn't recommend.

He is very passionate about teaching; however, his methods are not for everyone. He is very dramatic and at times a bit disorganized. He has a lot of tics that might annoy some people. While his train of thought is often heading to an insightful and interesting place, it sometimes gets lost on the way there.  Super easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had so much fun this semester!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved his class!

Joe was an amazing professor and I would love to take his class again. You can tell he loves rhetorical analysis. He does bring up the TV show Succession quite a bit, as well as Kanye West, Taylor Swift, and Elon Musk. He is very accessible outside of class time, and he makes sure you know where and how to find him.
If you aren't a super confident writer but need ENG 105 credit, Joe is perfect. Genuinely cares about everybody in class and lets you revise any assignment unlimited times.

By far the easiest A I got all semester. He goes on a lot of tangents, but I tended to find them pretty interesting. If you're an English major or particularly care about learning about the field, maybe choose a different professor, since there were some days we straight up just watched TV shows in class that vaguely related to course content

Joe is really nice, and very accessible outside of class if you need help. This class is great if you want an easy A and enjoy talking about pop culture. He does go on a lot of tangents and I didn't really leave the class feeling like I'd learned much about writing though.

Joe is a nice guy, but rambles about unrelated stuff for most of class and frequently goes off track so I didn't get much out of his lectures. He is very friendly and tries to connect to students, but goes over the top sometimes. Almost all in-class work is group work, but rarely is it productive. He is a lenient grader and is very accessible.
Take him! I would 100% take him again. Hoping to have another class with him in the future.
Professor Telegen (Joe) was a great 105 instructor and made the course super easy!

Honestly loved Joe.  He is a very easier grader but lowk bipolar.  He rambles in class but you don't have to listen.  Ended with a 100 in the class.  You can submit assignments as many times as you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really recommend to anyone. Great professor.
Good GPA booster. Very caring and is always there to help you. Do the work and you will have a good grade.
Easiest teacher ever. Very accessible outside of the classroom. Overall, an easy A

This professor is quite odd. If you want an easy 100 I would recommend but beware because he goes on random tangents and you will not learn anything about English. He is obsessed with Succession and he makes us watch it both in class and for homework. Have fun!

Joe is probably one of the EASIEST Engl105 teachers you'll find. If you want an easy A take this class cause there are unlimited revisions on everything. If you actually want to learn something, then that's debatable cause he tends to go on a tangent often. Extremely accessible outside of class and very accomodating however.
A huge waste of time. Joe doesn't give a lot of clear instructions on homework so you may need to revise a couple of times before getting an A. But overall an easy class.

Honestly, a very nice and funny guy, is pretty accessible outside of class too. But, he expected us to know a lot of things and may not exactly be the best professor in terms of teaching. Good thing is, he makes the tests pretty easy compared to the other Calc 3 classes. I'd recommend teaching yourself a lot outside of lectures.

great guy and really funny in class. We did sometimes speed through lectures, but I felt like he still did a good job explaining things. There was also a lot of time doing practice problems, so I generally felt ready for the midterms. He also made sure you were prepared for what would be on the tests. underrated professor for sure
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Really nice and a funny guy, but he tends to speed through the course. He is caring and if you keep going to his office hours you will be all good, but don't expect his lectures to be helpful.

Dr. Noonan was a very funny and nice guy, but was not a good professor. Our tests/exams made up 90% of our grade, and I never felt prepared for them. He is a very smart guy, but expected us to be on the same level as him. If you take him, prepare to spend hours outside of class studying and preparing for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Noonan is a very fun guy to be around. He did his best to make the atmosphere of the classroom positive and engaging, but he seemed to expect everyone to know the material very easily, as he has been doing it for decades. He's new to UNC, so he's still figuring things out, but he has potential to be amazing.

If you have already taken AP AB or BC, you'll be fine. If you haven't, strap in, because he goes SUPER quick. It's clear he knows the material super well, which means he kinda expects it to click for you super quickly too, but obv that's not always the case. But he's SUCH a nice person, and is always willing to meet and review.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Noonan is a great example of great person, somewhat lackluster teacher imo. He is lively and brings good energy to his classroom. However, his teaching is not my cup of tea. The material that is on exams is very different from what's practiced on homework/class. It was often "figure it out" with not much else for help. I felt unprepared.

Noonan is a really nice guy and definitely cares for his students, but his lectures were difficult to follow and things got off topic quite often. His midterms were also pretty difficult, as well as the Edfinity homework. Would only recommend if you have a good foundation with Calc.

Professor Noonan was such a great person and I enjoyed having him but the class itself was not the best. He was very all over the place and felt like we didn't have enough time to do anything. He is new though, so I think he's just getting the hang of thing and hopefully future classes will be more organized. I had to teach myself most material :(

I'm retaking calc from high school, so ik that calc is generally a hard subject. His lectures are pretty engaging and he's a funny guy. Doesn't go into as much detail as I would prefer. Offers a lot of help (had a video tutorial request form, and loved office hrs--but I never used either tbh). Edfinity homework sucks tho. 

Shoutout to my TA tho

Professor Noonan is caring but I would not recommend him for 231. He is nice, but lectures were hard to follow and he always jumped straight to the answer instead of actually walking through any steps to solve a problem. He blurred the lines between what steps were actually needed and what was extra "fun" stuff that you could do if you wanted.

Noonan is a truly a kind person, making an effort to remember your name and make 231 really entertaining than most sections. But most of us agree that he tends to ramble about things that aren't important to the curriculum at hand. the ULAs in recitation were def better at teaching than he was in general. also poll everywhere is used for attendance

Math 210 feels like a math class for people who don't like math, and Noonan does a great job teaching to that crowd despite being a math guy himself. I found him very entertaining. The lectures and due dates were a bit disorganized. But it's his first semester here and I'm sure he'll get into a groove.

I really like Noonan as a person and he wants the best for his students, his only down fall is the lectures. He gives a worksheet to work through and just gives the answers at the end of class. This was his first semester teaching here, so he was figuring out what worked along the way, so hopefully future classes will have more productive lectures.

Dr. Noonan is lots of fun! Teaching style could definitely be improved, but he's engaging and silly, and answers specific questions pretty well. I leaned HEAVILY on the ULAs in the class to actual learn material and prepare for tests... probably would've failed without them. Overall fun, but you're left to learn a lot of material on your own.

Professor Noonan is a funny and caring guy in lectures, but he did not really teach us anything. From what I have experienced and heard from my classmates, we all ended up teaching ourselves the course. Some lectures were good, but he didn't find ways to improve after people did terribly in the midterms. Class felt like a waste of my time

He's super nice, but his midterms were a lot longer than the other sections' midterms were. He also tends to do the math problems that he has fun doing in class, rather than focusing on what's on the exam. He loves math and he's passionate about what he's teaching, but he focuses a lot on what's he thinks is fun rather than on the curriculum
Justin is a nice person and a good teacher, but beware of the 13 in-person quizzes!

This was the easiest class that I have ever taken at UNC. While class is optional attendance, he is very excited about the subject material making his lectures pretty engaging. Two papers and two online take home exams are the only grades in the class, but they are graded easily. Recitation is chill and gets out early. Take this class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only 2 papers and 2 test. Wasn't a hard class, kind of boring. Overall easy way to get a focus capacity.

I liked this class! I didn't come to lecture often (optional attendance), but the lectures were interesting sometimes. Graded by two 5-page papers, a midterm, and a final. Good gen ed option to consider! I recommend going to recitations. Our midterm and final were taken at home. He's also really chill, used to be a high school teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Information heavy slides make it so that purchasing the textbook isn't even necessary (like I don't recommend spending your money). Professor Nolan is a great guy but the lectures themselves are extremely fast-paced and monotonous. Your only grades in the class are two papers, a midterm and final but are all relatively easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was unsure of Nolan at first bc this was his first year teaching the course, but my doubts quickly dissipated. Even for a optional attendance 3:30 that is far away from where I live, I made it to almost every lecture. Nolan cares about his students and is chill af

("City and Regional Planning" not "Architecture") Very funny, down to Earth, and kind. Fast-paced lectures. Detailed PPTs. Not much HW. Papers: 2x20% | Midterm: 25% | Final: 25% | Recitation Participation: 10%. Easy grading on papers. Vocab-oriented exams (there are hundreds of vocab terms so studying takes a long time). Good choice for a Gen-Ed.

Lectures were not productive as he would just repeat the textbook and go off on random tangents. Test average for the first exam was a 63% and he blamed the class for not paying attention during lectures.  If you really want to succeed in this class, then you would have to read all of the chapters assigned in the textbook--which mind you, is a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: would only really take this class if you are a political science major. i took this for the gen-ed credit and had a hard time. lectures are boring, Roberts moves through material super quick, and tests are relatively hard. you def can do well, but it requires A LOT of studying/work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class average on the first exam was a 63 and blamed it on us for not memorizing extremely obscure details. Class lectures are boring and unengaging and he often stops lectures to call people out for small talk.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I honestly learned more in recitation than in lecture. He is not very engaging and can sometimes come off rude. First exam had a 63% average in the class and did not suggest any changes on his end to help our performance. There is definitely a way to do well in this class, but it requires a lot of effort outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For a first year seminar, class was difficult for no reason. Graded by a few things, so messing up on the exams doesn't help your grade. You never really know what to expect on the exams, so they were difficult. Not reading heavy but lectures are boring. Professor is nice but any other first year seminar would be easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 2 papers and 2 exams. For a 100 level class you genuinely have to lock in, and the papers are graded strictly and if you do bad on one exam then your grade is predetermined.

Overall, Roberts is a good/engaging teacher. He was very knowledgeable and kept class moving at a good rate. The exams were fairly hard but not cumulative and the papers were pretty easy if you utilize resources (TA and teacher). Do the reading to understand what he goes over in class and not have to worry as much about notes while he is talking.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was fine and uninteresting but not very hard if you read the textbook. Going to class was completely useless as he just repeats parts of the textbook you already read, but he takes attendance through quizzes. My TA was fantastic though and graded papers fairly. I just wish class time was more productive as I taught myself everything.

I was disappointed in this class because I was so excited to take it and knew it was going to be an easy A. Roberts was very all over the place during his lectures and got distracted most of the time. Most of the info on the exams was not talked about or just briefly skimmed over in the lecture. There's no way I should get a B- in a 100 level

Class is incredibly easy if you review the lecture slides and skim the textbook. The biggest issue would be the professor. Dr. Roberts, at times, had this aura of "I'm better than you" during his lectures. He would also use most of the class to just answer questions, without getting to the content. Overall, take it if you need an easy A.

This class is very lecture heavy so please please please pay attention during his lecture. Hie class his weighted on 3 exams, 2 papers, and participation in his class. READ THE TEXTBOOK! The most beneficial thing to do in his class is to read the textbook.
This class was based on 3 tests, which was unfair and not based on what we learned what so ever. He isn't a bad lecturer but they were not helpful. Would not recommend unless you want have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Roberts is very easy to listen to and led very interesting lectures. However, his class is oriented around 3 exams and 2 papers. The exams are pretty tough, with a lot of trick questions. You have to read the textbook thoroughly and keep up with the lectures completely. The papers are slight. He does not curve exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests are hard for no reason. The second test (out of 3) had a 68 average. There are extra credit opportunities (to which I personally went to almost all of them) but not enough to come back from how bad the tests are. Normally an interesting lecture, but would not recommend.

For a 100-level class, this class is unnecessarily hard. The tests are hard to pass because it is based on the lecture slides and he words the exams so tricky. The average test scores were 70s and he does not curve them. Essays are easy but the exams will bring your grade down.
Definitely do not recommend.

Prof Roberts is very knowledgable, fair, and organized. He's not very flexible or accomodating, but the class is not too hard and the workload is reasonable. Totally fine professor and interesting class. Do the readings and you will be fine.

Class only consisted of three tests including final, two paper, recitation, and poll ev (had so many issues with poll ev technology).  Pretty chill class and getting a good grade is possible.  Keep up with readings and definitely study lecture slides for test.  Try to get Michael Greenberger for your TA; fair grader for papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: roberts was very nice and a good professor, but he did pollev for attendance. the papers were graded easily, but the tests revolved around the lectures and sometimes included irrelevant and hard-to-remember information. for a 100 level class, however, it was easy and relatively laid back.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, I enjoyed professor Roberts' course. The class grade revolves solely around tests and papers but the more you studied and listened to lectures, the better off you'll be. I would recommend him as he is clearly knowledgeable and engaged in politics, making it easier to not get bored.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Roberts had fairly interesting lectures, but the entire course is 3 tests and 2 papers, with participation taken through PollEv. Tests were extremely difficult and had many trick questions. Averages were in the 70s for all exams and he does not curve. TA's grade the papers, 3 and 7 pages in length.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Even if you knew all the material, the tests had badly worded questions. He didn't curve the exams even tho our 2nd exam average was low. Pollev was used for attendance but he used it halfway through the semester and many people had problems with it including me. He did not listen to problems and would not curve anything. Would not recommend.

Professor Roberts graded participation through Poll Everywhere, with accuracy counting towards full participation credit.
