reviews.comment: I do not understand how she has a good rating. She constantly changes instruction, her assignments are unreasonable and adaption to COVID was awful. Do not take her or Spanish 105 managed by her.

Prof Lindquist was the coordinator for my Span105 class. The course is unorganized and frustrating. She allowed the quiz format to be changed from online take home to in class in the middle of the semester. I would recommend doing span101 and 102 over the 105 accelerated course. Or, do community college Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This lady stinks. She runs all the SPAN105 classes and is not lenient at all. She wants everyone to get a B I think. Also, there's way too much work. I swear even for a 4 credit hour class. I had average Spanish experience before and thought I could ride it out and I was so wrong. Just don't take Spanish as a language so you can avoid her regime

Prof. Lindquist seems unaware that most students enrolled in SPAN 105 have not taken a Spanish class in person for years because of COVID. Her lectures are extremely rushed, she is often condescending, and creates very strange assignments. Will be finishing my language credits at a community college after this.
She was very unspecific and constantly moved things around. Do not recommend, so many other options in terms of spanish professors.

I loved this prof Im just very bad at Spanish and school online. She and all the other profs (combined class) were very kind and while my grade might not reflect it I feel like I did learn a lot of Spanish. Grades by a lot of things so that is nice. Would take her for 203 if I could

Dr. Lindquist is one of my favorite Spanish professors at UNC. She cares about her students and the subject matter. The class can be dull due to the subject but she always makes it interesting with her humor and finding ways to get students involved. She will randomly call out students to answer questions so it is important to do the readings.

My high school spanish teachers were awful, but even so I'm pretty sure she is good at her job. Very extroverted and agreeable, fun to be around. She was very forgiving and willing to work with students on late work. Did cold-calling, but that's standard for every 105 class and we learned to get good at it. Work didn't seem excessive.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Josefa is really great. Like in any language class, participation is really important but she doesn't make you feel stupid when you get stuff wrong. I got a fine participation grade though and I didn't talk every class so its not that bad. She isn't super picky about pronunciation in class either. She is super funny and wants her students to learn

Professor Lindquist was absolutely lovely! I took her 8 am M, W, F online and she always brightened my day. There is a lot of homework required, however, it doesn't take long at all. If you have a background in Spanish it is a very easy class, but make sure that you keep studying all of the material. Overall I would highly recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Lindquist is the end-all-be-all SPAN105 professors. Easily my favorite UNC professor so far. Amazing lectures that are incredibly engaging. This is definitely the only 8 am I've ever looked forward to just because she makes learning spanish so fun. If you have the opportunity to take 105 with her DO IT!!

OMG WHAT A QUEEN. This woman is the greatest teacher at UNC. Periodt. She genuinely wants you to do well & makes class bearable. There's a lot of homework, but it helps a lot in class & on her quizzes. Highly Recommend!!!

Dr. Lindquist is truly amazing. The only professor I've had that made me look forward to 8 AM lectures. She's very approachable and her office hours are a must (she gives plenty of feedback that will help you thrive in the class). Pretty tough on participation, just don't skip and you'll be fine. Would definitely take her again if I could!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: What a woman. I wish I could've taken 203 with Lindquist. Hilarious woman, always wants you to do well. Makes 8am spanish bearable. If you're taking 105 cuz you have to she will actually make you enjoy the class. What a gem.

Dr. Lindquist is an amazing professor, she will make you want to come to class and learn Spanish, even if it's at 8 AM. Having her class first thing was a great way to start the day, she is always lively and entertaining which definitely helps when trying to learn a language.

The nicest professor at UNC. Shes so funny, caring, and passionate about Medieval Spanish! She brought us donuts for our final exam because it was at 8am. I would literally die for this woman. Definitely a lot of reading, and she does call on people to encourage participation, but shes really nice when correcting your Spanish! 10/10

Profesora Lindquist is a gem. She's hilarious, and although the subject matter (Early Modern Spanish literature) is a bit dry, she makes class engaging and fun. Only one essay for the whole semester, but it's a 13-15 page paper requiring six secondary sources. She doesn't grade super hard and gives good feedback. Take a class with her!

Dr. Lindquist is honestly one of the nicest and most caring professors at UNC. Each student's success genuinely matters to her. Her lectures are always interesting and funny. Though the material can be difficult, she is very fair and really works with students as long as you participate in class.

Professor Lindquist is one of the kindest, most caring teachers I have ever had. If I ever needed extra help she would video chat with me or meet with me in person whenever we both were free. She was always engaging in class and never let us give up if something was too difficult. Cannot recommend her enough!
Such an amazing lady, she's amazing and really makes sure you're engaged and understand the material. And honestly she's so iconic.

Dr. Lindquist is one of the best teachers I have ever had. She wants nothing more than for her students to succeed and this shows with the numerous online video conferences she has if you cannot make it to office hours. Speaking of which, I highly recommend going to office hours, the personalized help is amazing and I would recommend her to anyone

Josefa has been one of my favorite professors in my whole time at UNC. She made this class so much fun and was always encouraging in helping students learn. She goes out of her way to make sure students succeed and is very fair about her grading. If anyone ever gets the opportunity to have her jump at it!

Josefa is hands down the #1 choice for SPAN105 at UNC. Not only does she want you to understand the material, she WANTS you to do well in the class. She will video conference at night if you need extra help and always make time for you during her days on campus. Truly a GEM!!!

Lindquist is engaging and genuinely cares about helping her students learn. You will get out as much as you put in, but take advantage - she is a great teacher. I had a background in Latin so 105 has been tough but definitely manageable as long as you stay on top of vocab.

Josefa is super sweet and funny! take a class with her! she really cares about you doing well in her class and shes super nice in office hours. you do have to participate in class. there is a lot of assignments but that just means that if you do bad on a couple things it won't ruin your grade. fast paced class, but doable if you put in the work

Josefa is very passionate about the works studied in class, and it really reflects in her lectures. She is a fair grader, her tests/papers aren't graded harshly, and overall she gives you the means to succeed in her class. 10/10 would recommend taking a class with her!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Lindquist is such a fun and amazing professor! Class was never boring. She is also wonderful at teaching the material and cares a lot about her students. Also she loves UNC so much... it's awesome. Take her class!

You MUST take Josefa for SPAN105!! Honestly the best Spanish professor I've ever had. She is hilarious with a great sense of style, is always willing to help, and makes the class fun! Really makes it impossible to NOT learn Spanish.
Josefa is an amazing professor! She is very clear on expectations, so as long as you do the homework and study, you can get an A.
I LOVE JOSEFA! Everybody does. Seriously makes class so fun. Take her!!

I LOVE Professor Lindquist, she made what could be a boring class engaging and exciting. She is so passionate about Spanish literature and it really comes through in the classroom. She just wants you to learn something from the works we read in class. Workload is never too bad and tests are very straightforward. Take this class with her!!

Professor Lindquist is a great teacher. I took SPAN101 online with her, weekly online class is about 2 hrs. long and mandatory. Lots of homework! Must keep up to pass this class. She is great to work with though and will even meet with you individually to help you understand something. Tough grading on pronunciation though. Overall a great teacher!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really loved Lindquist, she's very funny & doesn't take anything too seriously. Most of SPAN105 is review from high school, & she's REALLY big on class participation. She'll call on anyone randomly, but will never get angry if you don't know the answer. The tests are fair & pretty easy if you start studying a few days early.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She is amazing and inspirational.  There is a lot of homework and preparation to do well, but the effort is well worth it.  Her office hours are always filled with students going in and out - if that tells you how incredibly helpful she is.  She is always willing to help if you are having a difficult time. The class will always brighten your day!
Lindquist is the best Span 105 professor. She loves the topic and makes class interesting. Homework is manageable. Highly recommend!

This is a great class and a wonderful professor! She loves what she teaches and makes you excited to learn Spanish.  The grading is fair for tests and quizzes and she is very willing to help outside of class. I would definitely recommend this class!

This was an overall good class and Dr. Lindquist was very engaging and HILARIOUS. However, the tests were relatively hard for me (but I didn't start studying till the night or two before). Most of her tests and quizzes have to do more with the harder stuff of Spanish, not just straight up memorization of terms. Would take her again though.

I was pleasantly surprised by this class. There was a good amount of work and class participation is a must, but the grading is fair and it is relatively easy to do well. The final project is time consuming but not awful. Overall, great teacher!

This was actually my favorite class of the semester. Because it's a smaller class room (about 20 students), expect to participate a lot. I learned a lot and really enjoyed the class. I'm definitely trying to get her as my professor next semester.
Great balance between fairness and the chance to make an A while balancing learning and actually teaching you something.  She is also really funnya fun person to be around.
She cares about the students and enjoys teaching her subject.  She speaks in Spanish most of the time, but not beyond what the students can understand.  The class was a lot of fun.
She is very funny! and easy going:)

Loves teaching and cares about her students.  She knows everyone's names and makes the class enjoyable and fun.  It is discussion based and she makes an effort to get to know all her students.  I highly recommend her.
A very fun and enthusiastic teacher.  Also very kind and helpful.  She actually got me to enjoy Spanish, which I didn't think was possible.

Very enthusiastic, loves what she teaches. She can be very hard to follow, most people get lost during class. Class is discussion-based and calls randomly on people, which is tough. Assigns readings for every class, sometimes entire plays/narratives, very time consuming. Good if you appreciate poetry / lit. Tests aren't bad at all though!

She is extremely helpful and really cares about her students. She is pretty laid-back, but a really effective teacher. She makes the class fun! I loved having her for Span 105! I would love to have her as a professor again!
Josefa is a lot of fun and made the 9 am class worth it. Even though she is the department head, she is super laid back. Very easy to talk to, office hours very helpful.

Great professor and engaging lectures, but exams are very difficult for a 101 class. Average tends to be low 70, and the wording on questions seems to be intentionally confusing. I enjoyed the content matter but was not the free A i expected.
Really interesting lectures!

Dr. Loeb is genuinely so engaging and hilarious. Her lectures were enjoyable and easy to listen to. The exams were a bit more difficult than anything in class, but she provides outlines for each unit leading up to the exams. Definitely take 101 with Dr. Loeb!

Dr. Loeb is hilarious and every class was engaging! The class is very textbook and lecture heavy. Spread the textbook readings out and write down the examples she gives in class as they are helpful when memorizing for tests later on. Great class!!

Absolutely loved Professor Loeb. Even for a class with 350 students, lecture was extremely engaging and hilarious. Midterms were very easy and logical. While there was no curve on midterms like previous sections, we did receive a generous curve for the final (not cumulative and very easy).

The class was fine in terms of difficulty. You have to study for the tests alot but u do have a lot of opportunities for extra credit. It is not hard to get an A in the class what so ever. The lectures however are so boring but decent class to take

Actually enjoyed going to class! Really flexible grading - allows drops for every grading category, including exam. Attendance assignments give you lots of credit just for showing up! Tons of extra credit chances. Do the work and you'll get a decent grade.

Prof. Loeb is by far my favorite teacher I've had! This class is solely lecture-based, but she is incredibly engaging and hilarious. I genuinely enjoyed every class and felt like the time flew by. Easy A if you show up and pay attention since she covers everything you need in class. Honestly never even opened the textbook but did very well.
honestly easy to get an A if you put effort in.
Loeb's exams are fair.  However, not an understanding professor with regard to class policies and attendance.

Great professor! Recommend showing up to the lectures as you'll learn most everything you need to know just by listening. Spend a few hours studying before each exam, and you'll be fine. Great class for anyone studying or interested in psychology.

3 exams, she drops the lowest one. 1 non-cumulative final. Not a great lecturer, but not bad. Quizzes at home over each chapter (best 8/11). Participation assignment each class, but you have 3/4 absences. Particpation Pool required, which was annoying but is for all psyc classes.

lectures are engaging and build off of the textbook. Read the textbook and take quiz at home before class. Participation is taken every day, but three are dropped. Also, extra credit oppurtunities just for talking in class and she gave us a 10% curve on the final. Would highly recommend for a freshman.

Such funny and memorable lectures. A lot of textbook reading so be prepared for that. If you take good notes probably will take 2-3+ hours per chapter. Exams were pretty difficult, but she does give you a broad study guide.
i love the lectures so much, i would totally recommend!!

Prof. Loeb is great and if you need to take Psyc 101, I'd recommend taking her. Her exams are really easy (I think our class average was above 80 every time) and she gives out extra credit for participation. The textbook is a lot of reading and she doesn't record lectures, so you're out of luck if you're sick.

Was not understanding of student's circumstances, gave a 0 for my exams despite having a legitimate excuse, which was heartbreaking, especially since she's a psychology proffessor.

Lectures were great though.

She is hilarious. It's a big class but she still is able to get people to engage through bonus points and her analogies are memorable. This class is hard though, it is a weed out class, it has SO much information, it has a 600 page textbook you'll need to read, and the tests are hard. It's a good class and Loeb is great but be prepared to work hard

Great introductory course! It's not difficult to get an A as long as you read the textbook and pay attention in lecture. Don't bother with the daily extra credit, it's so little that it doesn't make a difference. She also gives out comprehensive study guides for each exam!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Loeb's class! Attendance is required, but her lectures are so interesting and easy to sit through. Definitely take good notes from the textbook and lecture, but it's easy to get an A. Readings and quizzes are due before lecture. 3 exams, 1 non-cumulative final and lowest exam is dropped. Highly recommend!
contradicts textbooks, lectures are not good, lecture slides are bad, not accessible outside of class, tests are crazy unfair

Professor Loeb is a real gem. Her lectures genuinely made me laugh. 101 is a heavy content course: much to know and do. It's important to get every point possible, attend every lecture, and do all the readings. Even then, I still found Dr. Loeb's MCQ tests very difficult. To make up for this, there are ample opportunities for extra credit.

Nothing but good things to say. Attendance questions are a must, but there is no homework besides chapter quizzes. You have to read the textbook, but it's not hard. She is super kind and hilarious! Very understanding and made the class enjoyable. Every class has extra credit opportunities. The final exam is non-cumulative. She's the best.

Prof Loeb is a great lecturer and made class very entertaining with her humor. Her tests are very application based, so make sure you are reading the textbook section for each unit. Lowest midterm grade is dropped, final is non-cumulative, and participation is a huge chunk of your grade. I learned a lot in psyc 101 and prof Loeb made it fun!

If you have to take psyc 101 take it with Dr. Loeb. She is a extremely engaging and funny lecturer. The course material gets to be a lot sometimes, and she does make her exams very difficult, but they are all MCQ, and it is not hard to still do well as long as you do the readings and show up to lecture!

She is a great professor but her test are not super fun. Her exams are the definition of "psych professor made" she really does her very best to trick you in the exams. Over all tho she was really funny and engaging and her class is set up for you to succeed! Her Tas' were really nice as well and very helpful though!

Great and funny professor. Gives out extra credit like it's nothing! However, do not let this class fall beneath your other ones, as anything in the readings could pop up on the unexpectedly difficult exams. But once you know how difficult they are, you are fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very funny and engaging lecturer! Gave a lot of extra credit opportunities and ways to pad your grade. Exams are relatively straightforward, but it is important that you read the textbook chapters/take good notes.

She is so engaging! I loved going to her class. It was easy to learn and really fun. She gives a lot of extra credit and wants to make sure everyone succeeds. I haven't met anyone that doesn't love her.

I LOVED Dr. Loeb, and the class is doable. Participation is a lot of your grade and exams are not worth a lot, so its really easy to get an A. One exam gets dropped and she ended up giving us a lot of points back on another. I missed so many classes, never read, and needed a 41% on the final for an A. She is super engaging and funny in lectures too

She is very funny and uses a lot of profanity. She is also a little scary but you will succeed in the class. You need to memorize the textbook chapters for the tests, every detail could be a question. Even though the tests are multiple-choice, they are not easy. Never email her directly, she will get annoyed. Email the class email or her TA's.

I loved this class and Dr. Loeb is amazing! You definitely have to take notes from the textbook and lectures in order to study for exams, but the content is interesting and she is very engaging and humorous. I would say the first exam is the hardest, so don't let it scare you too much because you can drop one exam. It is an easy A if you study.

I changed this course to pass/fail so it wouldn't go into my gpa, so I didn't really try and still ended with a B. I think if you put in some effort you can definitely get an A in this class and Loeb is so funny and gives some of the best lectures I've had.

If you haven't taken AP Psychology you will be reading A LOT. You are accountable for nearly every page of the textbook, and the tests are nitty gritty. PSYC 101 my hardest class this Sem (more work than CHEM 101 and BIOL 101). Loeb lectures well and there are systems in the class to help you succeed. Overall the class is fair + I learned so much!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great, interesting lectures with funny jokes. Tests can be difficult but she gives a LOTT of credit just for showing up. Attendance is 30% of your grade and you can miss multiple classes and still get full credit. Readings are time consuming but not boring or complicated. I never got an A on an exam (midterm or final) and still ended with an A.

Dr. Loeb made this class so interesting! Her tests are hard; make sure to take notes, read the textbook, do the study guide, and you will do fine. She drops the lowest test grade, but gives extra credit sometimes (so study for all) and extra credit showing up to class before a long break. Also, read through her notes posted on Canvas! Def recommend

Loved Loeb's lectures as they were extremely engaging and funny. Lots of reading but it was manageable as long as you don't fall behind. Exams can be tricky, but the study guides she provides are enough. Study a lot for them as they are highly specific and can contain obscure course content either from lectures or the readings.
Lots of reading. Take detailed notes about both reading and lectures as the tests are VERY tricky. You really have to understand the material to be well prepared for the questions on the test.
Dr Loeb clearly cares a lot and is hilarious. Her exams are not hard if you pay any attention or read the textbook. TAs are generally useless but that's okay.

Dr. Loeb is an amazing and hilarious professor. Attendance is mandatory, but it is worth going to because things that she mentions in class will definitely end up on the test. The test are difficult with the questions being very specific, but if you go to class and study from the textbook, the class will be manageable.

Dr. Loeb has great lectures and is very funny. Although her lectures are informative, the test are extremely hard and all based off the textbook readings. Make sure to read all the chapters, and you have to remember the most random facts from it for the exams.

Ms. Loeb is a great lecturer. If you read the chapters ahead of time and pay attention you will do well. This course requires a lot of memorization. The midterms are pretty difficult- expect to be humbled on the first one. 3 midterms, final exam is NOT cumulative. READ CHAPTERS IN DEPTH. Random facts are on exams.

Professor Loeb is a very entertaining and helpful professor! She makes the lectures interesting, and her outlines for each unit are very helpful for the exams. The exams are somewhat difficult, but if you spend time studying the outline you should be fine. She also drops the lowest exam grade which is great. Overall, a great professor and class!

Dr. Loeb is an amazing professor! To do well in the class you HAVE to read the textbook, take detailed notes during class, and complete the study guides because her tests are difficult. There's a small amount of extra credit and tests are randomly curved. The final is non-cumulative and she drops your lowest test score along with several quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very good introductory course. Relies heavily on the textbook, homework quizzes after each chapter. Exam content comes from both textbook and lecture. She's incredibly knowledgeable; she'll always add extra content to the lectures. Make sure you read and pay attention, she's very entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb is funny and clearly passionate about psychology and is clearly a knowledgeable professor. Her lectures are hilarious and informative however she tends to move slowly and go on tangents often. She gives extra credit! The exams aren't bad as long as you use the study guides properly and they're curved.

Psyc 101 is a weed out class, but I thought Dr. Loeb taught it incredibly well. If you apply yourself, pay attention and show up for lectures, and DO THE STUDY GUIDES the tests don't have to be that difficult. She also drops your lowest test grade and 5 lowest quiz grades (there are a bunch, but they are all async) overall was a great class!

Do the reading and pay attention in class; it is important if you want to do well on the test. The first exam is the hardest, and you can drop your lowest score. She gives out extra credit and curves some exams randomly. The tests are incredibly difficult and are made up of memorizing random people and facts.

Dr. Loeb is an amazing professor. She knows the class is long but makes the lectures hilarious. This is a class where you have to read the textbook to get good grades on the tests. She does offer a little extra credit but it's not enough to make up bad test grades.

Dr. Loeb is definitely a character, so if you don't like inappropriate humor, take another professor. First exam was the hardest, but you can drop 1 of 3 exams, so it was no big deal. The final is non-cumulative. Also, do the readings, because the reading quizzes are hard and timed (I suggest typing notes so you can Ctrl > F).
Great Professor, tests are reading heavy and can be difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: LOTS of textbook reading. Exams are super easy and always curved as long as you follow the study guide. TAs were incompetent and never answered my questions. Lectures got annoying b/c she gives extra credit for speaking in class so lots of people talking about nothing. Lectures also very boring and never followed guided notes which was frustrating

I took AP Psych and got a 5 on the exam with ease. PSYC 101 here is so much harder. Almost your entire grade is made up of the 4 exams you take and the one, singular assignment in the class. It is ESSENTIAL to do the reading AND pay attention in class. Even if you understand the readings and lectures well, the tests are still incredibly difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I loved this class, the lectures were so engaging and funny. Attendance/participation is taken in class, and there isn't a way around it. The exams are difficult, but one of them gets dropped. Be sure to read the textbook for exams, her lectures don't always cover everything. I would highly recommend taking this course!

She's a great professor and lecturer, really entertaining and she is very enthusiastic and engaging. Her exams are difficult, but one is dropped. Be sure to read the textbook and follow along in the lecture.

Dr. Loeb is a hilarious professor who makes the material engaging. Exams can be challenging, but the dropped exam score and extra credit opportunities help balance things out. Unstuckstudy AI was a great study tool alongside the textbook.

Hilarious teacher. However, her exams are DIFFICULT. Thankfully she drops your lowest exam score. I would pay full attention in class, study healthily for 15+ hours, and I would barely scrape a B- on exams. Median grades on exams were ~67% sometimes, with only 5% curves. Thankfully exams are just 55% of your grade. It was, however, quite stressful.

Hilarious teacher, makes lots of innuendos and jokes, but is very good at explaining concepts. If you study, you'll be fine. She also gives extra credit if you come to class on the days before long breaks!

This class can be hard, but she gives so many freebies: extra credit for participating, drops lowest quiz/exam grades, etc. It can be really hard to make a lecture interesting, but she is hilarious and does a good job. You have to pay attention to everything she says: even a personal story can make their way into a test. Never used the textbook.

Alright heres the deal, she gives funny lectures but by the end of the semester you will just not want to come to class. If you spend enough time reading the textbook and taking notes you will be fine. Lectures really don't cover what is on the tests but the chapter outlines are helpful. 1/3 midterms gets dropped which is also nice.
Professor Loeb did a really good job of making lectures super engaging with funny comments and tips to remember things.
Took this as my first UNC class and I loved her!! such a good class and don't be intimidated by the 55% exam grade. Also you don't need to get the textbook
She's really boring.

Dr. Loeb was one of my favorite professors of my first semester at UNC. Her methods of teaching were captivating, inspiring, and comical. She used incredible aspects of pedagogy (which is one of her research interests) such as incentive-based learning, videos, interactive activities, etc. Dr. Loeb is also incredibly personable.

Dr. Loeb is a great teacher, her lectures are amazing, and she's hilarious. One issue I didn't really like, tests are not based off of the lectures, they're based off the textbook chapters, which isn't terrible, but I'd prefer to cover test material in class. Once you get that down though, tests aren't terrible.

Dr. Loeb was very knowledgeable and often tried to make lectures very interesting. There is a lot of reading and it is super important to attend lectures or you will fall behind. Not that many assignments, and the tests/quizzes aren't super difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb's psyc 101 class is definitely a weed out class. I was delusional when I thought this would be an easy A. She is a good person and gives extra credit, but she is incredibly nitpicky with tests, which basically determine our entire grade. I took calculus and biology at the same time and had the most work in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: IDST 112 as a whole is awful, but Dr. Loeb's sections were probably the least painstaking. I'm not really interested in psychology but I would honestly take one of her psych classes. If I were you, I absolutely WOULD NOT take this triple-i though, God speed.

Prof. Loeb's content were okay for this course. It was not super engaging, but at least she tried to cover all the materials on test. Her reading materials were the most extensive one, with many extra content that were not tested. Her lectures are often not very related to the readings as well. Overall, most learning are done outside of class.

Dr. Loeb was a great lecturer and had very interesting content that was easy to engage with. I don't think I would take a class with her again because she didn't interest me enough to want to go into psych or neuro, but she was a good enough professor especially for such a large class.

I had Dr. Loeb for my Triple I (death and dying) and her lectures were very captivating and interesting! Her portion of the class is relatively easy, so long as you keep up with the readings and study before exams.
She's a great lecturer and getting a good grade should not be that hard. Make sure you study, do the outlines she provides and read the textbook.
Loeb was great, and her lectures were pretty entertaining. You're going to need to take notes and study if you want an A, though, which is exactly why I got a B+.

Lectures were engaging and funny. Read and go to class. Exams are easy. Drop policy for attendance (top 80%), quizzes (top 7/11), and exams (top 2/3 midterms). Dr. Loeb and the IAs are not very accommodating outside of that. She needs to factcheck a bit; once claimed that Roman vomitoriums were where people would throw up. That's just not true.
Funny, understanding, and chill. Exams are kinda hard but just study a day or two in advance. She gives out extra credit like candy. Overall, great class and prof and I can't recommend enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Loeb is the best psych professor I've ever had. She's genuinely funny and cares about people. She gives bonus credit for just showing up on hard days. One exam is dropped, all multiple choice. Couldn't recommend her enough.

Dr. Loeb is super kind and lectures were always interesting and entertaining. There's a lot of easy ways to get bonus credit in class and the tests are all very easy and straightforward as long as you study and attend lectures. Overall an enjoyable class!
I really liked Dr. Loeb! The class was hard but her lectures were really cool. For midterm and final, please please know the readings well. I almost sold because of this.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is not as easy as everyone says. BUT, if you put in the work, your grade will reflect it. If you pay attention to lectures and take good notes, you're set. Answering the questions she asks publicly for the 0.03 extra credit is not worth it. It won't do anything for your grade. I answered everyday and it did nothing to my grade.

Interesting lecturer who clearly likes what she speaks on, however, lectures are rarely tested on and instead the main focus of the class was on the readings. Study guide for midterm wasn't helpful as the readings were basically the only thing on the test. Very engaged with students who want to learn more about Psych or Neuroscience

Professor is fine, actually very personable compared to most. However, PSYC 101 should not be this difficult. I had to spend more time on this class than any other class I've ever taken and im a neuroscience major. Loeb needs to understand PSYC isn't important and 101 definitely isn't. Don't make it harder than it needs to be.

Loeb is easily the best professor I have ever had at UNC. She's hilarious, makes the subject really engaging and gives so many opportunities for extra credit. Some days she gives you bonus credit just for showing up. She drops an exam. Definitely take class with her.

Super generous with XC. Medium difficulty overall. Lots of content and you have to read the book. Exams could be worded more precisely. She's very good at explaining things tho. Show up to lecture, read the book, and study for exams, and you'll be fine. Also, she loves to use sex as an analogy for everything, fyi.

I absolutely loved Dr. Loeb! She was such a joy to have as a professor and always made class very engaging. I would definitely take PSYC101 if you can with her. The only thing about her class was the fact that some of her exams weren't the greatest...a bit obscure sometimes in regards to the wording of questions.
Solid. Harder than everyone says. Be ready to memorize. Hilarious, good woman.

I'm currently taking this professor for my triple I class "Death and Dying" and I just have to say I'm disappointed and frustrated. First, this Triple I is easily one of the hardest ones out there. Second, her parts of the exam are all trick questions. Lastly, she expects you to know every little detail from every single reading. TLDR: don't take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is awesome!!! Definitely worth taking and highly recommend! Read your textbooks and study for your tests and the class is can be an easy A. She teaches in a really helpful way as long as you attend class and take good notes. :)

One of the most hilarious professors I've ever had, relates to students very well.  Her examples really helped to remember concepts.  That said, reading the textbook is critical as the exams are challenging.  She does really care for students, however, and is very generous with XC. Highly recommend.

Dr. Loeb is very nice and generous with grades. Her funny anecdotes seem initially engaging, but eventually became corny and irrelevant. Exams weren't a great indicator of core content mastery, more regurgitation of niche class examples. Class is run by TAs, which can lead to confusion. Overall, a decent experience with a few hiccups along the way.

Attending class is mandatory, as she says things during class that do not appear in the readings. I'm not a science person and thought this class was difficult because of the amount of science-based terminology in the first half of the class, but not impossible. Would highly encourage to read the lectures and start studying several days in advance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb is an amazing professor. Her lectures are super engaging and fun; she explains concepts in a way that makes so much sense. Textbook readings can be a lot, make sure to start in advance. She clearly loves psychology and is so knowledgeable on the subject. I can not recommend her enough, if you are taking psyc 101 take it with Dr. Loeb!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Loeb is a great professor and obviously cares a lot about what she teaches. She does not post any slides to go back and look at outside of class, so make sure you go to class to get the information. Take good notes for the exams, they are tough, but manageable if you go to CLASS. Loeb was a great professor, but I am glad Psych 101 is done.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb is awesome. She makes lectures engaging and interesting. With that said, to do well on exams attendance is mandatory and you MUST read the textbook. This class also had the most extra credit opportunities I have ever had in a college course.
Great professor, engaging lectures. Exams can be tricky, so be sure to read the textbook and attend lectures. 10/10.

Dr. Loeb is honestly so amazing. She's very passionate, her lectures are intriguing, she's witty, and she gives a lot of extra credit for the students to succeed. Although her exams can be tough, the class is not predominantly exam-grade-based. I love her and I would definitely take her again.

I loved this professor. The tests were very easy and reflected the content. As long as you download her notes outlines and read it will be fairly easy. She also curves A LOT. The first test she curved 8.5 points. She is funny and her lectures are super engaging. The only slightly annoying thing is the heavily weighted attendance policy.

Prof Loeb is amazing. Great lectures, very clear grading and class outline, and relates well to students. Class isn't hard if you do the readings and pay attention. Would absolutely take her class again.

Loeb has very engaging lectures and knows her stuff. However, your tests count for a lot of your grade, and they're definitely difficult. If you're not good at applying content/info, then be prepared b/c the tests are all application. Participation matters. I really enjoyed the class and her lectures, but I have found it difficult to keep an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: LOVE Dr. Loeb. Tests are definitely hard and there is a lot of reading, but she is genuinely so caring. Lectures were always hilarious and she is so passionate about the subject. Definitely a good balance of difficulty, and I learned a lot.

Dr. Loeb is awesome!!!! Great lecturer, very engaging. Lots of opportunities for points/ to boost your grade. Heavy on reading but if you do it, exams are not difficult. Participation is a big part of your grade!
She is very kind and understanding! There are many opportunities for extra credit but the exams can be pretty difficult. If you study and read the textbook this class should be pretty easy.

Prof. Loeb is genuinely one of the best teachers I've ever had. Even in a 200-300 person lecture hall it was so easy to learn from her. She makes content relatable and always cracks jokes. There is so many opportunities for EC and as long as you stay on pace with textbook readings and listen to lectures, it's a super easy course, def. recommend!

If you read the textbook, take good notes and pay a little bit of attention during class then it'll be easy, you just need to study a bit before each exam. she gives a lot of extra credit and bonus points on exams, so it boosts your grade by a lot

Loved Professor Loeb. Super interactive and does extra credit if you answer questions or participate. Her in-class assignment, which shows you are present in class, are not graded on accuracy, which is nice, but she usually tells the answer eventually. Great at making topics relatable to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lots of extra credit opportunities. Loeb is a great lecturer and the class is super interesting. We have quizzes which are easy, exams aren't difficult but do require a lot of studying/memorization. Reading the textbook is important. Attendance isn't technically mandatory but there are in class assignments you can only complete if you go.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Favorite professor so far at UNC. Lectures are witty, entertaining, and easy to follow. She is very well spoken and makes psychology fascinating. The workload consists of one-two textbook readings a week, which are 30 pages and come with an easy quiz. Exams are considered to be tough, but your reading notes help and she gives exam extra credit!

passionate prof. She changed tests to closed notes 3 weeks prior to the exam after the drop period; however, she gave a massive bonus credit. Lots of extra credit. I would recommend doing these things to get a good grade... read EVERYTHING, take notes, annotate note outlines she gives, find examples for concepts.
Great prof, I highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb is really entertaining and I would recommend taking 101 with her because she makes boring material seem interesting. The tests are pretty difficult but she gave us a 20-point bonus on the first one due to a syllabus error and is allowing notes on the final because she doesn't want people to stress out. Lots of ways to get bonus credit!

She is literally the best. Study guides are super representative of the test. You need to go to class, but if you take good notes the exams are super manageable. She gives extra credit too. TAKE LOEB WE LOVE LOEB!!!!

I think Professor Loeb would be a great teacher outside of 101. You basically have to teach yourself everything in this class, going to office hours will be needed if you want to pass. The test are so hard for no reason, I took Psych 101 already but wanted to retake it here and it is a weed out class and the material is the same.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Interesting lectures (she loves to relate things to s*x), but three exams are worth 51% of our grades, and the exams are HARD. Lots of textbook reading, and you must complete 6.5 hours of outside research for the course. Not my favorite class, but I would recommend Jeannie if you are going to take PSYCH 101.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is a very caring professor, but I must note that she changed the syllabus 3 weeks into the semester. Exams are difficult. If you take the class, either study very hard or have good background in introductory psychology
Actually, the bonus credit was 20%. No wonder the exam avg was an A. Questions seem to come almost directly from the posted outlines.

Wow, she corrected a syllabus error about the exam like 12 weeks ago - and gave 15% bonus credit for it, and gives exam review guides for every exam. Topics are interesting and the class is well structured (you get credit for coming to class)!

She is very passionate about psychology. But, I must admit that changing syllabus 3 weeks into semester and making exams closed-notes is ridiculous. She expects you not just to memorize everything but be able to apply concepts. I like the idea of applying the concepts, but it is INTRODUCTION TO PSYCHOLOGY, not an advanced psychology major course.

She changed our syllabus 3 weeks into the class and made all exams closed notes. I feel as though it is of a very unprofessional and irresponsible nature to make such drastic changes to the syllabus after the drop/add period has concluded because it leaves students in a difficult position to adapt to such changes on the fly.

LOVE Dr. Loeb. GO TO LECTURES and you'll be fine. Exams focus on what she says in lecture and often is not found in the textbook. Our exams were open note/book so go to class, take good notes and you're good. She also dropped our lowest exam and there are lots of extra credit opportunities just by participating. She knows what she's talking about

Professor Loeb was amazing! Her lectures were engaging and she gave multiple opportunities for extra credit. Exams are worth 51% of your grade so make sure you take good notes and use the study guide to prepare. Overall a great class and it wasn't too challenging as an introductory course - just a lot of content.

prof Loeb is engaging and interesting but BEWARE this is not the easy A ppl say it is. 3 exams are worth 51% of your final grade and the questions are incredibly convoluted and designed to trick you. lots of extra credit and grade drops but it's not enough; I had 100s in everything else but barely got an A- bc of the exams.

Much harder than I thought it would be. Tests were insanely hard and felt like they could be part of a graduate level course or something. People thought they made them hard since they were taken outside of class so were open note. Also, class is really not that important to go to. What matters most is the textbook. Make sure you know it.

Super easy and interesting class if you need a PL credit. Dr. Loeb is quirky and clearly cares about her students. Grading is generous - over half of the assignments were dropped, and exams were online, multiple choice, and open book/notes.
Professor Loeb is a great professor and tries to make learning fun. She is very nice and funny. I enjoyed taking Psych 101 with her.

Loeb is a good lecturer and the content is very digestible even with a large amount of reading. The quizzes and assignments are also very easy. The test can be brutal though, as the question are designed to trip you up and can be frustrating. Not an easy A but far from a hard class. Take if you need the PL credit.

Dr. Loeb is so interesting, knowledgable, and funny. Even though 101 is pretty basic content, she made it interesting and I enjoyed attending lectures. It's a lot of reading but I know many people in the class just skimmed it and did fine, although you definitely get more out of the class if you are thorough. Quizzes are easy if you do the reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The tests are extremely hard and the lectures are sometimes hard to be engaged in. Professor Loeb is a very nice woman and she knows her information. The homework assignments were very easy and didn't require very much work but the tests are horrible.

If you don't cheat, this class will be a nightmare. TAs are rude and unhelpful and she's nice but the lectures are pointless and don't help. You basically teach it all to yourself by reading the textbook and pray for the best in the exams. That said, this is sadly one of the better options for PL/PX credit, but don't take if you can avoid it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: At first I was not the biggest fan of Psyc 101 because the exams were WAY harder than I anticipated especially since everything else in the class is so easy. Dr. Loeb can be a little condescending at times but she is super funny and upbeat. She gives so much extra credit and grade forgiveness which helps a lot. I would take Psyc 101 with her!

Took this class because everyone said that it was an easy A and she was a great teacher. A ton of reading and tests are extremely hard. Even if you go to all classes it is still a bunch of tricks and requires 100% understanding of every single piece of material. Good idea to not take this class if you are looking for an easy A gen-ed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Loved her! The structure of the class is kind of confusing but lectures themselves are easy to follow. Loeb is a great professor and makes psych 101 ten times more interesting! She gives extra credit opportunities and its fairly easy to get a good grade!

I did not enjoy this class. The class was split into thirds so you only go in person one day and the others online. It was easy work but a lot of work. One open note quiz a week and one hw assignment a week (a chapter a week). I mean, it was easy, but only if u r able to keep up w due dates and are dedicated to understanding the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great class for introducing standard level psychology. Professor Loeb made her lectures interesting and added a twist with her bright personality. She provided lots of extra credit opportunities too.

Super easy class, mostly common sense. Loeb was slightly all over the place with how she taught but all you need to do is look stuff up and make sure you're understanding the right things. She was funny and tried her best to engage us. Was super accommodating. Easy A overall
Decent professor, I did the bare minimum and still managed o pass with a B+, that being said tests were kinda rough
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Simple class to navigate; Loebs class infrastructure is excellent. Lectures are fun and she tries to engage the class despite its size. Doing a 2/3rds online hybrid this semester wasnt ideal, but everything you need is accessible. Very professional and organized prof.

Overall this class was decently easy if you've taken Psychology in high school before. There is a lot of busywork overall, but the best way to understand the material is by attending lectures. I would definitely use outside resources such as the textbook and previous quizlets to help you study!

Great lecturer! Not an easy a but it's possible. Most of the course grade comes from quizzes and homework assignments. Don't be fooled by everything being open note. Not a lot of time is given for quizzes and midterm/final so study before, since answers can't be found online and there isn't enough time to look everything up.

NOT an easy A, don't be fooled like me. I thought it would be common sense but this class is a lot of work. Weekly chapter quizzes and assignments. Lots of extra credit opportunities though. Also Loeb makes every lecture oddly sexual by using a metaphor or a literal example, so if you blush easy maybe skip this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you work hard in class you can get a good grade. This isn't an easy A, but there are tons of extra credit and it's definitely possible if you study. Tests can't be looked up so don't even try. There is a midterm and final for 38% of the final grade. The other % is Hw, Quizzes, Etc which you can get a 100% on easily. Remember the vocab as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Loeb was my favorite professor I had this semester! Her lectures were super engaging and she is hilarious! All the assignments from the beginning of the semester were clear and as long as you put in the work outside of class, you will do great! Could not recommend Dr. Loeb enough and I hope to be able to take another class with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Loeb was great, and the class was fair, but I would've enjoyed the class more and performed better had I not had life troubles this semester.

Professor Loeb was great! She has a great sense of humor which made the lectures fun and engaging. The class is overall pretty easy, weekly textbook quizzes and assignments with a multiple choice midterm and final. Everything's open notes and it's not difficult. Extra credit is also really easy to get. Definitely recommend.
Overall the class was extremely easy with every assignment, quiz, and exam being open notes. There were countless extra credit opportunities throughout the course.

Dr. Loeb is a GEM. She is so hilarious and told lots of jokes during lecture. The grade is determined by lots of small homework and quizzes, and she gave us tones of extra credit for attending lecture or answering a question. Cant imagine people complaining that it is hard. Just take Psyc101 with her!

One of the easiest classes I've taken at UNC - decent amount of work but its interesting and the tests come almost straight from the outlines, can't believe people complain that they're hard. Loeb is really funny and a very engaging lecturer, I actually learned a ton and really enjoyed her HILARIOUS anecdotes. A must take!

If you have to take Psyc 101, then take it with her. The class itself is not particularly interesting and mostly common knowledge but it is what it is. She has a ton of small assignments but everything you need for the class is given in the textbook or her very helpful pre-made notes. Everything is open book so don't memorize even if she says to.

Professor Loeb is really nice! Honestly, just be prepared to take matters into your own hands with this course. PSYC101 is very textbook-based and all Loeb does is repeat what's in the book with a little added information that isn't really relevant for big tests. Nonetheless, I enjoyed this course!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Take Dr. Loeb if you get a chance!! She is hilarious and provides personal stories to help you remember content easier. Exams were open-note but make sure you know the content as the questions and time limit make it challenging. A ton of extra credit was offered by logging onto Zoom, participating in class, and posting quiz questions.

Loeb gives very entertaining lectures with plenty of stories (so no falling asleep), but material we are tested on is much more in depth than what is covered during class. Lots of easy homework/participation grades, but the exams are extremely difficult.
She is a gem. Take this prof. Clear grading. Fair tests. Heavy workload. Lots of reading. Great support team. Don't take? -missing out!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Clearly an intro class - there's going to be at least 200 people. Dr. Loeb is absolutely hilarious and knows Psych material like no one else. She breaks all the concepts down into really simple terms and gives examples that you'll remember because they are so bizarre. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Lots of busy work though.

This was the only class I've ever taken where I actually wanted to watch the lectures. Dr. Loeb's lectures and recording are hilarious and she does a great job at keeping your attention. The quizzes and classwork are easy, however the midterm and final do require studying and are definitely more challenging.

I did not enjoy this class, but it could have just been the pandemic. Some of the exam questions were not in the lecture when it was stated in the beginning of the semester that one could either do the readings or watch recorded voicethreads. Quizzes - 25% Midterm - 19% Final - 19% Chapter assignments - 30% Research assignment - 5%. Exam question2%

Professor Loeb is fun and the structure of the class is great - I love that students had the option to do asynchronous or synchronous assignments. There is a lot of reading, but the weekly quizzes and exams are fairly straightforward, and she drops multiple low quiz grades. Requirements and expectations are always very clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr Loeb seems nice but the amount of time I had to invest in this class was not worth it for a 101 course. Her lectures often took hours to watch as there was no speed button and taking notes was important, and you really can't do well unless you have a background in psychology from high school, or you read the TB, watch lectures, attend class,more
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb is really funny and super sweet. She makes class interesting and very engaging. There are many options to do well in the class and LOTS of extra credit! There are only two exams (midterm and final) both with information coming straight out of her outlines.

Take Loeb for sure. Two exams-midterm and final. Final is non-cumulative. Lectures get weird sometimes (she's a weird gal) but it's funny. Material is stupid easy, show up to class, do required assignments, fill out the study guides, and you'll get an A. Barely put in work for this other than taking notes and I'm pretty sure I'm getting an A.

Really just an all around strange person. Her constant attempts to seem relatable and put things in easily understandable terms made her come across as unprofessional, and her rapid fire humor ended up making me feel weirded out. The course is very easy but the heavy and often stupidly-simple workload made it feel like a high school class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Loeb's lectures were hilarious and fun! She makes learning PSYC101 interesting and relevant. She is amazing at keeping students engaged and wanting to be there. Great teacher.

HILARIOUS and lots of extra credit and work wasnt too difficult. lecutres were engaging. she expects you to know your material. I did well all semester except the two exams were difficult and brought my high A to a B+ becuase it was 40 percent of my grade. i studied hard but the multiple choice were difficult with not a lot of time

Professor Loeb is a real gem! She's super funny and obviously cares a lot about her students. She's also extremely knowledgeable on the topics discussed. The online format of this class was a bit confusing and it was difficult to grasp all of the material but overall, I recommend taking a class with her.

Had a so-so experience this semester. Lots of quiz drops and extra credit, but 40% of the grade was two subjective multiple choice exams with no grade changes. Heard great things about her in-person, so maybe online just wasn't a good setup for her style.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: OMG! Loeb is AMAZING. I did not expect this class to have so much reading and content, but Loeb offers recorded slides to help you understand. Wonderful lectures and teaching style. Lots of extra credit, 0.05% each, but you don't need them to get an A. Make sure you understand each concept. Study hard before the exams. Trust me, take 101 with Loeb!

WORST PROFESSOR I'VE HAD. Does not care about students, will make it as difficult as possible for you to pass! I have a high GPA at UNC, so I'm not a poor student, but she is so caught up in bureaucratic red tape that she does not care if you learn the material or not. Your grade will reflect that. Disrepectful. IAs are also unhelpful/uncaring

Dr. Loeb was one of the best professors I have ever had. She is funny, and engaging, and her class is very interactive. There are many extra credit opportunities, but make sure you keep up with the readings. As the midterm and final are 40% of your grade, keeping up with the material is key for success in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's very nice and funny. There's weekly quizzes as well as the choice to do one asynchronous assignment a week or one zoom a week and you do the assignment with a group. It's pretty straightforward. The midterm and final exam make up a huge part of your grade though, so just do well on those and you should be fine.
I loved Dr. Loeb's explanations and real-world examples. Graded on chapter quizzes and assignments, a midterm and final exam. Many extra credit opportunities!!

Final grade was reliant on ONE midterm with zero chances of remediation. The fact that our entire grade hinged on the success or failure of one midterm exam is beyond disappointing. Furthermore, review of the midterm wasn't even permitted, so learning from our mistakes was an opportunity we never had the luxury to take! Very sad!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb was super flexible with this online format, and all the recorded lectures are presented in a way that's super memorable. Doesn't overwhelm you with assignments and has a super great grading policy for quizzes and assignments.

Professor Loeb is awesome. She's really laid back, but she's also a great lecturer and story teller. She keeps things interesting for sure. PSYC 101 is reading-heavy if you want to do well, but other than that, the class is very simple. Go to lecture, pay attention, do the readings, and you'll do well.

Loeb was amazing!! Really made just the information stuck with you and gave you opportunities for you to explain the content so that she could make sure that you understood the material. Also gave so many extra credit opportunities and participating in research studies are part of the course which was so much fun.

Professor Loeb is hilarious! Her lectures were amazing. As someone who hates science and was only taking this for the gen ed, she did a great job keeping me entertained. Her TA's were kinda jerks and not very understanding, but Loeb herself was super nice and gave a ton of extra credit. I hate stem classes and I still did pretty well so I recommend

Dr. Loeb is a wonderful professor who truly cares about her students. She gives ample opportunity for extra credit and her assignments are geared towards providing students a deeper understanding and engagement with the material. The outlines she provides helps with note taking and test prep. I would recommend this class to my friends.

She is an amazing PSYCH 101 teacher and I would highly recommend this course to any incoming freshman who doesn't really know what they want to do with their life yet. It's a low-stress class and an easy A as long as you keep up with the textbook readings. Lectures are funny and super interesting and you can tell she really cares about her students

I enjoyed having her as a professor. I also had her for a Death and Dying lecture and I think she's super knowledgable about psych. If you want to learn the most, take her class. If you do the textbook readings (there's a lot) then you should be fine.

Shes literally the GOAT. Good lectures, keeps it interesting by cracking a joke here and there. There are a lot of assignments that are more like busy work- easy 100's. You get extra points for participating in class

Dr. Loeb is a gem. She tries her best to make sure everything is as fair as possible when it comes to the test material, classes, and how the tests are given. I met with her outside class and she was helpful beyond the class itself, giving me advice that I will carry for the rest of my college experience.

I had heard great reviews about Loeb, that her lectures are engaging. Do not get me wrong, she is great but her lectures are pointless as I feel she rambles on tries to be funny and I wish she would post the class powerpoints too. hard exams. ditch taking many notes during her lecture since it is all stuff on her outlines and material in the book.
She's so amazing. One of the best professors I've ever had. Makes content easy to remember, interesting, and entertaining. Lots of extra credit if you participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! She makes her lectures incredibly interesting, and is funny and engaging with the students. Her material is clear-cut and what she teaches is exactly what appears on the test. You will be lucky to take a class taught by her!

Best Prof for Psyc 101! Hands out bonus credit like candy, reasonable amount of homework and quizzes but they are helpful for the exams. Exams require a solid knowledge of the material but nothing too hard. She often supplements the content of the textbook with lectures but apart from missing out on bonus credit you can get away w/ missing class.

Professor Loeb is amazing! She is so hilarious and actually makes you want to come to lectures because she explains the most important concepts and reinforces them with stories from her own life or from others'. The exams are not too bad, but you should definitely study. Attendance, assignments, and online quizzes boost your grade. Would recommend!
Dr. Loeb is very passionate about her teaching and makes lectures very interesting so it is easy to pay attention.

Dr. Loeb is a great professor and makes her class enjoyable. As long as you read the chapters, take notes, and come to class you should be fine. She also gives out a lot of bonus credit which helps your grade in the class.

Dr. Loeb is a very funny, engaging professor and keeps the class entertaining. She told lots of stories that related to content she was teaching which helped me remember and retain the information. The final exam was way harder than the midterms and I suggest studying a week in advance.
She is truly a great professor. Read the book and her outlines and you'll get an A. Offers many chances to do well in this class so I def recommend.
She is so funny, sweet, and erudite! I love her!

This woman is a gem. She makes her lectures super entertaining and really wants her students to succeed. If you screw up she gives you a chance to redeem yourself through EC opportunities, and she drops an exam. Make sure to stay on top of your reading and quizzes and do your participant pool and you'll do great. Highly recommend the class!

I actually like this class! It was taught by Chua,Loeb,&Larson. Though the lectures were very engaging, it's important to take notes in class and in your readings (incentivized through Sakai quizzes and in-class assign.). If you do not do your readings, you'll have a hard time on the exams. There were three major assign. throughout the semester.

PSA PEOPLE TAKE ANY OF JEANNIE LOEB'S CLASSES. She is literally the nicest person on campus. Also, all of her lectures are funny and she uses really memorable examples. There is a lot of reading but she drops a good amount of assignments so the workload is doable and she has good tests (3 a semester 1 is dropped). Anways she is a queen.

She is so sweet and truly cares about her students. She is also hilarious, which keeps the lectures entertaining. She is a big fan of bonus credit and wants everyone to do well in the class. Exams are pretty much like high school-level which was surprising.

Dr. Loeb's favorite word is bonus credit, which shows the type of professor she is. She wants all her students to do well in her class and enjoy it, so she offers extra credit, drops your lowest grades (including a midterm), and makes her lectures entertaining. you do have to go to class everyday though bc she does attendance checks every class.

Death & Dying was cool, with three profs (ENG, ANTH, PSYCH). You can drop over half the quizzes and the midterm only counts 20% . I found one of the assignment instructions to be a bit vague but ok overall. You get credit for participating in class.

This class was IDST 190, the midterm was extremely hard. You get readings about everyday and also daily quizzes that are 10 min each. The Lectures are sometimes boring and the professors go really quick and barely allow you to take any notes. The mid term is worth 20% of your grade! I wouldn't take this class again but Dr. Loeb is ok

Hilarious, very entertaining professor. Exams are straightforward, although there's a ton of information to absorb. Dr. Loeb has only increased my sureness that I'll continue my Psych major. Only necessity is show up, there's a ton of in class participation grades and she talks about many things apart from what's in the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is wonderful. You need to show up for in-class writing credit but she gives loads of bonus and she is very clear on what she expects of you in class and on exams. Easily one of the best professors I have ever had at UNC and I would recommend this class to anyone interested in psychology or making an easy A.
Dr. Loeb is great and gives ample opportunity for extra credit. She is funny and captivating, while also an effective teacher.

Loeb is definitely one of the best lecturers at UNC. She explains topics well, has a great personality, and is really funny in class. There's just one simple project, easy quizzes on textbook chapters, and lots of in-class extra credit opportunities. Not an easy A though, but if you pay attention, read the book, and study, you can certainly get one
She was really clear on difficult topics and gave funny examples to help you remember concepts. If you read the textbook, the exams are fine. Just be sure to study the exam guides she gives!

Everyone loves Loeb, but I personally didn't think she was the best. Her lectures were fine, sure, but they were fast and breezed over important topics while lingering on topics Loeb could make easy jokes on. The tests are borderline insanely hard while could be remedied by having a test on 2 chapters instead of 3 or 4. She's not bad, but not good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Loeb is the funniest professor I've ever had. She is always joking during the lecture about the class material and makes it so easy to remember everything. The tests are kind of difficult but there are many opportunities to raise your grade. If you have the opportunity to take her class, DO IT!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor, hilarious and energetic. However, she expects you to know TONS of stuff from both lecture and textbook, so make sure you come to class. There are also TONS of opportunities to get extra credit, but they do not add up much to the final score (perhaps only 0.5%), so definitely study for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's an amazing professor! She offers extra credit for attendance. I absolutely loved her lectures and she's very interactive with the class.

If you ever get the chance to take a class with Dr. Loeb, do it! She is one of the most fantastic profs I have had at UNC. She is hilarious and makes interesting and engaging for everyone. Plus, the class isn't that hard. There are some attendance checks so it's smart to show up, but there is a buffer if you have to miss some days.

The absolute best! Loeb is very funny and wants everyone to do good in her class. Tests are fair, bordering on easy, if you've done the reading, and there's not much of that. Lectures are engaging and she provides many many many extra credit opportunities!

Dr Loeb is the best teacher I've had. She is super nice and funny and makes class interesting. Read the textbook if you want to do well but if you don't read and just show up to class you'll still do fine. There are online quizzes every week on a chapter in the textbook and the chapters are about 30 pages but if you read then the quizzes are fairly

Shes super knowledgeable, well spoken, and always has the class cracking up at her jokes. She really is so passionate about teaching and is one of the best at conveying information and making complex topics easier to understand.

I would definitely suggest taking PSYC 101 with Dr. Loeb. Her lectures were very clear and made the course very interesting. The tests were not too bad, as long as you do all of the reading and go to every lecture you'll do fine. She also gives a lot extra credit for participation and open-note online quizzes which help a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I honestly don't know anyone who doesn't like Dr. Loeb. She is so funny and her lectures are always super interesting and inspiring. I thought PSYC 101 was going to be super hard, but Dr. Loeb gives out plenty of extra credit points if you participate and show up to class. The tests weren't all that bad either. She's among the best of the best.
Definitely take this class. Very clear and fair! Kind, funny, and caring professor

Dr. Loeb is AMAZING. By far the funniest professor at UNC (she makes jokes that literally have people bent over laughing), which makes every single lecture interesting and just plain fun. I was so engaged so often that I forgot to take notes. Excellent professor, excellent class, fair exams, and LOTS of extra credit opportunities. Take this class!

Loeb offers extra credit each class for answering questions during the lecture. As long as you have her class outline pulled up, you will be able to find the answers. However, I never even answered the extra credit and got the A, so this should be a low stress class to take.

Dr. Loeb is truly amazing. Not only is she knowledgeable about the subject matter and teaches it effectively, but she somehow finds a way to incorporate humor into all of her lectures. Tests are easy if you PAY ATTENTION in class and READ THE TEXTBOOK. Some questions on test can only be taken from class time, so attendance is mandatory for success
Loeb is the BEST! She is absolutely hilarious and has so much energy. Plenty of grades and makes it easy to do well if you put in the time. 100% recommend.

Dr. Loeb's lectures were entertaining and informational. There is a lot of information to know for the 96 question final, however the study guides she gives basically hints at all of the topics that will be covered on each exam.

Jeannie is an amazing professor. She is hilarious and makes this class very interesting. There is a TON of info to learn in this class and she expects you to know all of it. She gives out tons of extra credit though and it is easy to get. She is such a great professor and person. HIGHLY recommend.
Pay attention and read the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb is so great! This class was super interesting and I always looked forward to going. There is reading, but it is not too bad and is relevant to the course. But overall the course was great and Dr. Loeb is wonderful.
Loeb is great! I didn't take PSYC 101 for fun (it is requirement) but she makes it very interesting and fun.

Professor Loeb made lectures funny and interesting. The class wasn't too difficult if you read the textbook, and there's nothing on the exams that isn't mentioned in class. She gives extra credit for participating in class and the one project you complete is very simple and easy if you follow the directions!

Dr. Loeb was truly an amazing professor. Just do the work and youll be fine, there are 3 exams which are somewhat harder than the quizzes so dont just rely on lecture notes, actually read through the chapters in the textbook.
Jeannie Loeb is a good professor to have. Her class is easy if you continuously study & keep up with readings and quizzes. Also, make sure you go to lectures because she does attendence checks.

She was one of my favorite professors at UNC. You definitely need to study a lot and there is a ton of work, but she makes the class so much fun that it is easy to motivate yourself. I would recommend her to anyone!

This is my first semester as a freshman and so I was worried about the difficulty of college classes, but she is kind and funny and presents the information in a very clear way. I've already taken 2 of her exams and only had to study a little to review for the exam since she does such a great job of explaining during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Loeb is by far my favorite professor I've had at Carolina so far. Her lectures are always intriguing because she's hilarious, which makes it so much easier to wake up for a 9:30 class. The class itself isn't very hard as long as you do your reading and study and she's very fair with grading/participation bonus. Wish all my profs were like her!!

Professor Loeb is hilarious! She makes a point to engage with a large class and adds humor. She is SO smart and gives a lot of extra credit. There is a lot of reading and quizzes, but if you do the reading and take notes, the quizzes are extremely easy. It was a good PL credit and I would recommend her to anyone trying to fulfill that credit.

I would 100% take this course again. Loeb is a great professor who really knows her information and how to teach it. She works to make sure each class is interesting to keep her students involved. Show up to class, participate for extra credit, and complete all of the assignments and you will do well on the tests. IA's are very helpful and caring.

loeb is a great teacher! funny and caring for sure. wish i studied harder for the second test and final but all the extra credit makes an A attainable. no class on friday and the grading structure is great. definitely recommend

She is awesome and exceptional! She cares for you and the material. She is clear, fair, and organized, and there are dozens of opportunities for extra credit and bonus points.
